vi: Bò bước vài bước chậm, vẫy đuôi, ngẩng đầu kêu “ummm bò”, rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The cow takes a few slow steps on the spot, swishes its tail, lifts its head and gives a long deep moo, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a warm deep cow moo and soft hoof steps on grass.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the bare grape vine stem with the curly tendril and one small leaf bud, no grapes and no big leaf.
vi: Cành nho trơ mọc lá to, ra chùm hoa nhỏ, rồi kết thành chùm nho xanh, chín dần sang tím.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the bare vine stem sprouts and the big grape leaf unfolds, a cluster of tiny green grapes appears and swells, the grapes ripen from green to deep purple until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft rustling leaves and gentle little pops as each grape grows.

vi: Mặt trời mỉm cười toả nắng, gà trống vươn cổ vỗ cánh gáy “ò ó o”.
en: The smiling sun beams brighter and its rays twinkle; the rooster flaps its wings, stretches its neck and crows proudly, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud rooster crow 'cock-a-doodle-doo' and wing flaps, morning birdsong far away.

vi: Con cò cúi mổ bắt được cá, con kia nuốt cá; nước gợn, đàn chim bay ngang trời.
en: The stork in the water dips its beak and catches a little fish with a splash, the other stork tosses its fish and swallows it; ripples spread, the birds in the sky glide across, then everything returns to the original picture. Sound: water splashes, a soft stork clatter, wind through reeds.

vi: Các bạn nhỏ kéo co, ngả người giật dây về phía sau, mèo con níu theo; cười reo.
en: The children pull the rope together in a big tug-of-war heave, leaning back and stepping, the kitten tugs too, they wobble forward and pull again, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: children's cheerful shouts of effort and laughter, a little kitten meow (no words).

vi: Bà cười hiền, gật đầu, vẫy tay chào bé, khăn len khẽ bay.
en: The kind grandmother smiles warmly, nods and gives a gentle little wave with one hand, her scarf stirring in a breeze, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft warm chuckle (no words) and a light breeze.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the plain white enamel mug body without lid, without handle and without the flower pattern.
vi: Cái ca trắng trơn: quai bay vào gắn, viền hoa văn tự vẽ quanh thân, nắp xoay rơi xuống đậy “cạch”.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the handle flies in and clicks onto the plain mug, a row of little flowers paints itself around the body, then the blue lid spins down and lands on top, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: a ceramic clink, a soft brush stroke, and a metallic lid 'clack'.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small green eggplant flower bud on a short stem with the green calyx, no eggplant fruit yet.
vi: Hoa cà tím nở rồi kết quả nhỏ xanh, quả phình to dần, chuyển tím bóng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small purple eggplant flower opens, then a tiny green fruit forms under the green calyx and swells round and big, turning glossy deep purple until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft gentle growing sounds and a light pop.

vi: Chú chim vẽ trên ca sống dậy, hót, vỗ cánh nhảy một vòng quanh thân ca rồi đậu lại chỗ cũ.
en: The little bird painted on the cup comes alive: it chirps, flutters its wings and hops around the cup's surface, then lands back exactly in its painted spot. Sound: cheerful little bird chirps and tweets.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small yellow tomato flower on a short green stem with the green leaves of the calyx, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa cà chua vàng nở, kết quả xanh nhỏ, quả lớn và chín đỏ cam.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small yellow flower opens, a tiny green fruit forms and swells round, ripening from green to orange-red until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a light pop.

vi: Con cá bơi uốn đuôi, há miệng thả bong bóng, quay một vòng rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The fish swims with lively tail flicks, opens its mouth and blows a few bubbles, makes a playful little turn and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: underwater bubbling and soft swishes of water.

vi: Năm bạn gái nhún chân, xoay váy, vung tay múa theo nhịp.
en: The five girls dance: they bounce on their toes, twirl their skirts and wave their hands in time, then finish in the exact original pose. Sound: light rhythmic clapping and happy children's giggles (no words, no music).

vi: Gió thổi tán đa rì rào, rễ phụ đung đưa, lá rơi; hai người dưới gốc phe phẩy nón, chim bay về tổ.
en: A breeze rustles the big banyan crown, the aerial roots sway, a few leaves drift down, the two people under the tree fan themselves with a hat, a small bird flies into the branches, then it all settles into the original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, cicadas and a few birds.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the leather school bag still flat and unassembled: the front panel, back panel, flap and handle lying apart.
vi: Các mảnh da bay vào khâu lại thành cặp, quai gắn vào, khoá cài “tách”.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the leather panels fold up and stitch themselves together, the flap folds down, the handle flies in and the brass clasp snaps shut, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft leather creaks, quick stitching sounds and a crisp clasp 'click'.

vi: Người lái đò chống sào, con đò trôi chậm, nước gợn sóng theo nhịp sào.
en: The boatman pushes the long pole into the river, the little boat glides gently forward and rocks, ripples spread around the hull, then everything returns to the original picture. Sound: a pole splashing into water, gentle water lapping, distant birds.

vi: Dê vểnh tai, ngẩng đầu há miệng kêu “be-e-e” hai lần thật to như dê ngoài đồng, râu rung, đuôi ngoe nguẩy, rồi đứng lại như cũ.
en: The goat perks up its ears, lifts its head, opens its mouth wide and bleats loudly twice, its little beard trembling and its short tail wagging, then it lowers its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: the real, natural bleat of a farm goat (a loud, wavering, nasal baa-aa-aa), exactly like a recorded goat; no human voice, no talking, no music; a soft breeze over the grass.

start: Edit the illustration and change ONLY the palm tree; everything else stays identical: the plain ivory paper background, the same patchy blue sky strokes and white clouds, the same bushes and grass, the same framing. Remove the tall trunk and the high crown completely, and at the exact spot where the trunk meets the ground draw a young palm with no trunk: a low, wide clump of five fan-shaped palm leaves on short stalks rising straight from the ground, about as tall as the bushes.
vi: Cây cọ lớn đúng như cây thật: bụi lá quạt non sát đất mọc thêm lá mới từ giữa, bụi xoè rộng; rồi thân cọ mới nhô lên từ gốc, đẩy tán lá lên cao dần; tán luôn xanh đầy, chỉ vài lá già dưới cùng úa nâu rụng xuống để lại vòng ngấn trên thân, đến khi thành cây cọ cao như tranh.
en: Natural palm growth from the first frame to the last, like a real fan palm: first new fan leaves unfold one by one from the center of the low clump and the clump grows wider at ground level; then the trunk emerges from the base and slowly rises, lifting the whole crown of fan leaves higher and higher; the crown stays full and green all the way up, and only one or two of the oldest lowest leaves turn brown and fall off along the way, leaving ring scars on the growing trunk, until the tall palm matches the final illustration exactly. The tree never stretches like rubber, the crown never becomes bare, and the leaves keep their fan shape. Clouds drift slowly. Sound: a gentle wind and rustling palm leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but show only bare soil with a few tiny green grass sprouts.
vi: Mầm cỏ nhú lên, lá dài vươn ra thành bụi cỏ um tùm, gió thổi xào xạc.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: tiny grass sprouts push up from the soil and stretch into long blades that spread out into a thick bushy clump, swaying in the wind, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft rustling grass and a light breeze.

vi: Em bé ngã, chống tay, ngẩng lên, rồi cố gắng nhổm dậy, phủi tay (kết thúc về dáng ngã như tranh).
en: The toddler on the ground lifts his head, pushes up with his hands, wiggles his legs as if about to get up, gives a little sniff, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a small 'oof' and a soft sniffle (no words), a light thud.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the backpack still in separate pieces: the main bag body, the two front pockets and the shoulder straps lying apart.
vi: Túi trước bay vào gắn, quai đeo vắt lên, khoá cài bấm lại thành ba lô.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the two front pockets fly onto the bag body and stitch on, the shoulder straps swing up and attach, the leather buckles fasten, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: fabric swishes, stitching sounds and buckle clicks.

vi: Chiếc ô đang khép bật xoè ra “phựt”, mưa lất phất rơi trên mặt ô rồi tạnh.
en: A light rain starts and drops patter on the open umbrella, the umbrella gives a little bounce and spin, drops roll off its edges, then the rain stops and it settles back to the original picture. Sound: rain pattering on fabric and a soft 'whoomp' of the umbrella.

vi: Lá cờ tung bay phần phật trong gió.
en: The red flag with the yellow star waves and ripples strongly in the wind, then calms back to the exact original shape. Sound: flag flapping in a strong breeze.

start: Keep the same table, paper background and style, but show the same notebook CLOSED, lying flat on the table: only its blue cover with the running boy picture and the white label is visible, no lined pages.
vi: Quyển vở đang gấp trên bàn tự mở bìa ra, các trang giấy kẻ dòng lật nhẹ rồi nằm phẳng, thành quyển vở mở như tranh.
en: Opening animation from the first frame to the last: the closed notebook lying on the table opens by itself, the blue cover swings open, the white lined pages fan out and flutter gently, then settle flat, until the open notebook matches the final illustration exactly. The picture on the cover stays a still drawing. Sound: a soft paper flap and gently fluttering pages.

vi: Búp bê chớp mắt, nghiêng đầu cười, xoay váy một vòng như nhảy múa.
en: The doll blinks, tilts her head with a smile and does a little twirl so her skirt flares, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a tiny music-box chime and soft fabric swish.

vi: Búa sắt gõ xuống đe “keng keng”, tia lửa nhỏ bắn ra.
en: An unseen blacksmith's hammer strikes the anvil a few times, bright little sparks fly up from the top, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: ringing metal 'clang clang' of hammer on anvil.

vi: Dế mèn rung râu, cọ cánh gáy “ri ri”, nhảy nhẹ một cái.
en: The cricket twitches its long antennae, rubs its wings to chirp, then makes a quick little jump and lands back in the exact original pose. Sound: loud cricket chirping 'cri-cri-cri'.

vi: Ve sầu rung cánh kêu “ve ve”, bò lên thân cây một chút.
en: The cicada vibrates its transparent wings and sings loudly, crawls a little up the tree bark and back down to the exact original pose. Sound: the loud buzzing song of a summer cicada.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the wooden wardrobe as flat separate boards and two doors lying apart, not assembled.
vi: Các tấm gỗ dựng lên ghép thành tủ, hai cánh cửa bay vào bản lề, khép “cạch”.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the wooden boards stand up and slot together into a cabinet, the legs pop on, the two doors fly in onto their hinges and close with the little knobs, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks, a hammer tap and a door 'click'.

vi: Cô lái đò cắm sào xuống nước, đẩy mạnh, đò lướt tới rẽ nước thành hình chữ V; một chú cá nhảy lên cạnh đò, bạn gái chỉ tay cười thích thú; thuyền buồm xa xa căng buồm.
en: The boatwoman plants her long pole into the river and pushes hard, the little boat glides forward and the water parts into a V-shaped wake, a small fish leaps out of the water beside the boat with a splash, the girl points at it and laughs with delight, the boatwoman smiles and pushes again, the sails of the distant junks fill with wind, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a pole splashing into water, flowing water, a fish splash and a girl's happy laugh (no words).

vi: Hai hòn bi lăn vào nhau “cạch”, nảy ra rồi lăn về chỗ cũ.
en: The two glass marbles roll toward each other, collide with a click, bounce apart, spin and roll back exactly to their original spots. Sound: glass marbles clicking and rolling on dirt.

vi: Ô tô đỗ yên một chỗ, không chạy; đèn pha nháy như chớp mắt, cần gạt nước quẹt qua lại; bạn trai bỏ tay khỏi vô lăng, cùng bạn gái nhún nhảy trên ghế, vẫy tay chào qua cửa kính.
en: The car stays parked and does not move at all: the engine is off, the wheels do not turn and nobody drives. Its round headlights blink twice like friendly eyes and the windshield wipers swish back and forth once, the boy takes his hands off the steering wheel and, together with the girl, bounces happily in the seat and waves through the open windows, then everything settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: two soft clicks of the headlights, a wiper swish and children's happy giggles (no words).

vi: Ca nô rẽ sóng lao đi, bọt trắng tung, cờ bay phần phật.
en: The speedboat bounces over the waves, white spray and foam splash around it, the little flag snaps in the wind, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a buzzing outboard motor and splashing water.

vi: Chỉ là nụ hoa đung đưa: cành nhỏ khẽ lắc trong gió, nụ hoa chúm chím nghiêng qua lại, hai lá rung rinh; một chú ong nhỏ bay vòng quanh nụ rồi bay đi. Nụ không nở ra.
en: Only a gentle sway: the little branch rocks softly in the breeze, the closed flower bud nods from side to side, the two leaves flutter, a tiny bee buzzes in a small circle around the bud and flies away, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The bud stays a closed bud the whole time: it never opens, never blooms and never changes size or shape. Sound: a soft breeze and a tiny bee buzz.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the tamarind branch with its small feathery leaves and a few tiny yellow tamarind flowers, no pod yet.
vi: Hoa me nhỏ trên cành, kết quả me non xanh, dài ra, cong và chín nâu.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: tiny tamarind flowers bloom on the branch, a thin green pod appears, grows long and curved and ripens to brown until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft rustling leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background, the same long green leaf lying at the bottom and the same style, but remove the apricot fruit; instead, a thin bare brown twig enters from the top edge and holds one white five-petal apricot blossom on a short stalk, hanging above the leaf.
vi: Đúng như cây mơ: hoa mơ trắng trên cành nở, cánh hoa rụng, quả mơ xanh nhỏ nhú ra từ chỗ hoa, lớn dần và chín vàng cam, rồi quả chín rụng xuống nằm trên chiếc lá; cành nhỏ bật lên khuất khỏi khung.
en: Natural apricot growth from the first frame to the last: the white apricot blossom on the bare twig opens fully, its petals drop off one by one, a tiny green fruit forms where the flower was and swells round, ripening from green to golden orange on its short stalk; then the ripe apricot drops gently down and lands on the long leaf, and the twig springs back up out of the frame, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Flowers never grow on the leaf. Sound: soft falling petals, a gentle growing sound and a soft thump of the fruit landing.

vi: Bé gái đu cao lên rồi về, váy bay, tóc bay, cười thích thú.
en: The girl swings high forward and back on the swing, her dress and hair flutter, she laughs happily, then comes back to the exact original position. Sound: creaking swing ropes, a whoosh of air and a girl's happy laugh (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small green yam vine sprout coming out of soil, no tubers.
vi: Củ từ dưới đất lớn dần (cắt ngang mặt đất), mầm leo lên, củ to sần, có rễ con.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small sprout grows, and under the soil the yam tubers swell and lengthen with little roots, then the soil falls away to reveal them exactly as in the final illustration. Sound: soft earthy rustling and crumbling soil.

vi: Cậu bé gồng sức, nâng quả tạ lên cao, run run rồi đứng vững cười tươi.
en: The boy bends his knees, strains and pushes the barbell higher with wobbling arms, then holds it steady over his head and grins, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a determined little grunt and a proud cheer (no words), clanking weights.

start: Keep the same paper background, shadow and style, and the exact same papaya shape and position, but the papaya is completely dark green and unripe, with no orange or yellow at all.
vi: Quả đu đủ xanh nằm yên, chín dần: màu vàng cam loang từ đầu quả lan ra khắp vỏ, vỏ bóng lên, đến khi thành quả đu đủ chín như tranh.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the papaya lies completely still and never moves, rotates or changes shape; only its color changes: warm yellow-orange spreads slowly from the bottom tip across the skin in soft streaks, the green fades until only a little green is left near the stem, and the skin turns glossy with a tiny sparkle, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a soft magical shimmer.

vi: Cô y tá xoa bông, tiêm nhẹ; bạn nhỏ nhắm mắt can đảm rồi mở mắt cười.
en: The nurse gently dabs the boy's arm and gives the injection; the boy squeezes his eyes shut bravely, then opens them and smiles, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a soft reassuring 'shh' and a relieved little sigh (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background, the same patterned cloth and style, and the exact same vase shape and position, but the vase is plain, smooth and undecorated: pale ivory glaze with no blue pattern and no flower painted on it.
vi: Chiếc lọ gốm trơn được cây cọ vô hình vẽ trang trí: viền sóng xanh quanh cổ lọ hiện ra, cành lá xanh vươn ra, bông hoa cam nở trên thân lọ, rồi men lọ bóng lên lấp lánh.
en: Decorating animation from the first frame to the last: an invisible brush paints the plain vase, the blue wave border appears around the neck stroke by stroke, blue leafy branches grow across the belly of the vase, then the orange flowers bloom on it in paint, until the decoration matches the final illustration exactly; finally the glaze gleams with a little sparkle. The vase itself does not move. Sound: soft brush strokes and a delicate porcelain chime.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a tiny folded green leaf bud on a short stalk.
vi: Chồi lá nhỏ bung ra, lá xoè to, gân lá hiện dần.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the tiny folded bud unfurls and spreads into a big oval leaf, its veins drawing themselves in, until it matches the final illustration exactly; it sways gently in a breeze. Sound: soft rustling.

start: Keep the same road roller, driver, paper background and style, but the road in front of and under the big drum is covered with a rough layer of loose gravel and small stones.
vi: Xe lu nổ máy phụt khói, trục lu to lăn chầm chậm đè lên lớp đá sỏi, nghiền đá thành mặt đường phẳng lì; chú lái xe nắm vô lăng chăm chú.
en: Road-making animation from the first frame to the last: the road roller chugs and puffs of smoke burst from its chimney, the driver holds the wheel steadily, the big steel drum turns slowly and presses the loose gravel and stones down, crushing them into a flat, smooth road surface, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a heavy chugging diesel engine and crunching gravel.

vi: Ba ba thò dài cổ, bò chậm vài bước rồi rụt cổ lại.
en: The soft-shelled turtle stretches its long neck out, crawls a few slow steps, then pulls its head back and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: soft scraping of claws on sand and a little splash.

vi: Bê con dụi đầu vào mẹ, bò mẹ liếm con, kêu “ò”.
en: The calf nuzzles its mother, the mother cow turns and licks the calf gently and gives a soft moo, the calf wags its tail, then back to the exact original pose. Sound: a gentle cow moo and a small calf's 'maa'.

vi: Ong vò vẽ bay vòng quanh mạng nhện, vo ve, mạng nhện rung rung.
en: The wasp buzzes and loops around the spider web, the web trembles and glistens, then the wasp hovers back to its original spot. Sound: a loud buzzing wasp and faint rustling leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background, stalks, leaf and style, and the same two figs in the same positions but smaller, hard and plain green, with no speckles and no orange blush.
vi: Hai quả vả xanh nhỏ lớn dần, căng tròn, đốm lấm tấm hiện ra, vỏ xanh ửng từng mảng cam nhạt như tranh; cuống đung đưa nhẹ, lá rung trong gió.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the two small green figs swell round and plump, the stalks sway gently under their weight, little dark speckles appear on the skin and soft light-orange patches spread over parts of the green skin, until the two figs match the final illustration exactly: still mostly green with orange patches. They never turn red, dark or purple. The leaf trembles in the breeze. Sound: a soft breeze and a gentle growing sound.

vi: Tò vò rung cánh, bay lên một vòng rồi đáp xuống chỗ cũ.
en: The mud wasp flutters its wings, lifts off, circles once in the air and lands back in the exact original pose. Sound: a buzzing wasp.

vi: Hổ bước đi uyển chuyển vài bước, quất đuôi, há miệng gầm “gừ”, rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The tiger prowls a few smooth steps in place, its tail lashes, it opens its jaws and gives a deep roar, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a powerful tiger roar and soft padded footsteps.

vi: Chim tu hú mổ một quả chín, nuốt, rồi ngẩng lên hót “tu hú… tu hú”.
en: The koel pecks a ripe berry from the cluster and swallows it, then lifts its head and calls its two-note song, the branch bobbing, then back to the exact original pose. Sound: the koel's clear two-note call 'koo-ooh, koo-ooh' and rustling leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the millet stalks still green and thin, with tiny green flower heads, not yet bundled.
vi: Những bông kê xanh mảnh trổ hạt, hạt vàng dần trĩu xuống, rồi được buộc túm thành bó.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the thin green millet heads fill with tiny grains, turn golden and droop heavy, then a string wraps around the stalks and ties them into the bundle exactly as in the final illustration. Sound: soft rustling grain and a string tightening.

vi: Khỉ con với tay chộp, gãi đầu, nhảy nhót, kêu “khẹc khẹc”.
en: The little monkey reaches out and grabs at the air, scratches its head, bounces playfully, curls its tail and chatters, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: playful monkey chatter 'ook-ook eek'.

vi: Tay trái bạn giữ chặt thước trên trang vở, tay phải cầm cây bút chì trên bàn lên, kéo bút dọc mép thước từ trái sang phải, hiện ra một đường kẻ thẳng; bạn dời thước xuống kẻ thêm một đường, rồi đặt bút xuống, về lại như cũ.
en: Ruling lines in the notebook: the boy presses the ruler flat on the page with his left hand, picks up the pencil from the table with his right hand, and draws the pencil tip along the straight edge of the ruler from left to right, leaving a neat straight grey line on the page exactly along the ruler; he slides the ruler down a little and rules a second line the same way, looks at it with a satisfied smile, then puts the pencil back on the table and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: the scratch of a pencil sliding along a ruler and a soft page rustle.

vi: Như truyện Ăn khế trả vàng: một con chim lớn sà xuống đậu lên cành khế, ngó quả khế chín vàng, mổ nhẹ một cái rồi vỗ cánh bay đi; cành khế nhún lên xuống, lá rung rinh.
en: Like the folk tale of the bird that loves star fruit: a big black bird swoops down from above and lands on the branch, the branch dips under its weight, the bird looks at the ripe golden star fruit, gives it one gentle peck without damaging it, then flaps its wide wings and flies up out of the frame, the branch bounces and the leaves rustle, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: big flapping wings, a happy bird call and rustling leaves.

vi: Cá rô quẫy đuôi, dựng vây gai, đớp bong bóng.
en: The climbing perch flicks its tail, raises its spiny fin, gulps and lets out a few bubbles, wiggles forward and back to the exact original pose. Sound: water bubbles and splashes.

vi: Rùa thò đầu, bò chậm rãi vài bước, chớp mắt rồi rụt về.
en: The tortoise stretches its head out, crawls a few slow heavy steps, blinks, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: slow scraping steps on dry ground.

vi: Đài bật lên, mặt loa rung, nốt nhạc bay ra, ăng-ten lắc lư.
en: The radio switches on: the dial glows, the round speaker pulses in rhythm, little hand-drawn musical notes float out, the antenna sways, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a cheerful old-fashioned instrumental tune from the radio with a soft crackle, no singing, no speech.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a stalk with a cluster of tiny mango flowers and the leaf, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa xoài nở thành chùm, kết quả non xanh, quả lớn thuôn dài và chín vàng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the mango blossom cluster opens, a tiny green mango forms, grows long and plump and ripens to golden yellow until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and buzzing bees.

vi: Xe máy nổ máy “bình bịch”, ống xả phụt khói, bánh xe quay, đèn pha nháy.
en: The motorbike starts up and rumbles, a puff of exhaust comes from the pipe, the wheels spin and the headlight blinks, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a motorbike engine starting and revving 'vroom vroom'.

vi: Hai người kéo cưa qua lại nhịp nhàng, mùn cưa bay lả tả.
en: The two men pull the long saw back and forth in rhythm, sawdust sprinkles down from the log, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: the rhythmic rasp of a big hand saw cutting wood.

vi: Chim sẻ nhảy lóc cóc trên cành, nghiêng đầu, rung cánh, kêu “chíp chíp”.
en: The sparrow hops along the branch, tilts its head, fluffs and flutters its wings and chirps, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: lively sparrow chirps 'cheep cheep'.

start: Keep the same pond water, lily pads and style, but show the lotus as a closed green-pink bud on its stem, no open flower.
vi: Nụ sen từ từ nở bung thành bông sen hồng, nhị vàng hiện ra, giọt nước lăn trên lá.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the closed lotus bud slowly opens petal by petal into the big pink flower with its golden center, a water drop rolls across a lily pad, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: gentle water and a soft blooming whoosh.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the chayote vine with the big leaf, curly tendril and a small yellow flower, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa su su nở, kết quả non, quả lớn dần thành quả su su xanh có rãnh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small flower on the vine opens, a tiny green chayote appears and swells into the big ridged fruit until it matches the final illustration exactly; the tendril curls. Sound: soft rustling growth.

start: Keep the same paper background, colors, lighting and hand-drawn ink style, but show the wooden stool taken apart: the square wooden seat and the four separate wooden legs lying neatly apart on the ground, not assembled, roughly where the stool stands.
vi: Bốn chân ghế bật đứng dậy, mặt ghế bay vào gắn lên trên, “cạch” thành ghế đẩu.
en: Playful assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the four wooden legs wobble, hop up one by one and stand upright, then the square seat flips over, flies in and lands on top, each part snapping into place, until the finished stool matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: light wooden knocks and a satisfying click as each part snaps in.

vi: Đoàn tàu xình xịch chạy vào ga, kim đồng hồ quay, hành khách đi lại.
en: The train slides gently along the platform, the clock hands on the tower tick forward, passengers walk and wave, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a train horn, clacking wheels and a station bell.

vi: Con cua bò quanh miệng giỏ, giơ càng, rồi bò vào lại chỗ cũ.
en: The little crab scuttles around the rim of the bamboo basket, raises its claws and snaps them, then scuttles back to its exact original spot. Sound: tiny clicking claws and soft scuttling on bamboo.

vi: Gà giò ưỡn ngực, vỗ cánh, tập gáy “ò ó…” chưa tròn tiếng.
en: The young rooster puffs its chest, flaps its wings and tries a squeaky half-broken crow, shakes its head, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a funny cracking young rooster crow and wing flaps.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the corn ear still fully wrapped in green husks with only a little silk at the tip.
vi: Lá bẹ ngô từ từ bóc ra, lộ hàng hạt vàng mẩy, râu ngô bung ra.
en: Unwrapping animation from the first frame to the last: the green husks peel back one by one, revealing rows of plump golden kernels, and the corn silk fluffs out until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: crisp rustling husks.

vi: Voi vẫy đôi tai to, vung vòi lên rống “bơơ”.
en: The elephant flaps its big ears, raises its trunk high and trumpets, then lowers it back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud elephant trumpet.

vi: Nghé gặm cỏ, ngẩng lên nhai, vẫy đuôi, kêu “nghé ọ”.
en: The water-buffalo calf munches grass, lifts its head chewing, flicks its tail and gives a soft low call, then lowers its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: munching grass and a gentle calf call.

vi: Sóng biển vỗ, mây trôi, bé đắp lâu đài cát, bố cười nhìn con.
en: Waves roll onto the shore and the clouds drift, the boy pats the sand castle and adds a little tower, the father smiles and nods, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: ocean waves, seagulls and a child's happy giggle (no words).

vi: Cửa sổ bật đèn sáng lần lượt, rèm bay, cây lay trong gió.
en: The windows of the guesthouse light up one by one, a curtain flutters on a balcony, the trees sway in the breeze, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a light breeze and distant birds.

vi: Hai quả bóng bay lơ lửng, đung đưa, chạm nhau “bụp” nhẹ.
en: The two balloons float and bob, sway on their strings and gently bump into each other, then return to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbery squeaks and a light breeze.

vi: Phong bì tự mở nắp, lá thư nhỏ ló ra vẫy vẫy rồi chui vào, nắp khép lại.
en: The top envelope flap lifts open, a little letter peeks out and waves, then slides back in and the flap closes, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: soft paper rustling and a flap 'pat'.

vi: Thỏ nhảy cao qua bãi cỏ, tai dựng, đáp xuống rồi nhảy tiếp về dáng cũ.
en: The rabbit bounds high over the grass with ears up, lands softly, twitches its nose and springs again into the exact original pose. Sound: soft thumps of hops on grass and a light rustle.

vi: Chó xù vẫy đuôi tít, lè lưỡi, sủa “gâu gâu” vui vẻ.
en: The fluffy dog wags its tail fast, pants with its tongue out, gives two happy barks, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: friendly dog barks 'woof woof' and panting.

vi: Mẹ bước đi chợ, làn rau đung đưa, chó con chạy theo vẫy đuôi.
en: The mother walks along swinging her vegetable basket, the puppy trots after her wagging its tail and yips, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, a playful puppy yip and birds.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but show only a few short bamboo shoots poking up from the soil.
vi: Măng tre nhú lên, vươn thành cây tre cao, lá xoè, khóm tre rậm rạp đung đưa.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: bamboo shoots push up from the soil and shoot tall segment by segment, leaves fan out and the clump thickens until it matches the final illustration exactly, swaying in the wind. Sound: wooden creaks of bamboo and rustling leaves.

vi: Cá trê uốn mình bơi, râu ngoe nguẩy.
en: The catfish swims with a wiggling body, its long whiskers wave, it flips its tail and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: water swishes and bubbles.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the empty blue-rimmed plate.
vi: Từng loại quả lần lượt nảy vào đĩa: đu đủ, chùm nho, quả lê, quả khế.
en: Playful animation from the first frame to the last: the fruits bounce into the empty plate one by one, the papaya, the bunch of grapes, the pear and the star fruit, each landing with a little hop, until the full plate matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft fruity plops and a ceramic clink.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with the leaf and a small pale flower, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa thị nở, kết quả thị xanh, lớn tròn và chín vàng thơm.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small flower blooms on the branch, a round green fruit forms, grows and ripens to golden yellow until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds.

vi: Xe buýt và xe tải chạy qua phố, người đi bộ bước đi, lá cây rung.
en: The bus and the truck drive slowly along the street, people walk on the pavement, the leaves of the trees sway, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: street sounds, engines, a bus horn and footsteps.

vi: Bạn nhỏ lái ô tô đồ chơi lao đi, bụi tung, vẫy tay, bóp còi “pí pà pí pò”.
en: The boy drives the little toy car with a happy bounce, dust puffs behind it, he waves and honks, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a toy car horn 'pip pip pip poo' and a child's laugh (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the table top, table legs and the two chairs as separate wooden parts lying apart.
vi: Chân bàn dựng lên, mặt bàn đặt xuống, hai ghế tự lắp và trượt vào hai bên.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the table legs stand up and the tabletop lands on them, then the chair parts fit together and the two chairs slide into place on each side, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks and clicks.

vi: Đàn ngan lạch bạch đi, vỗ cánh, kêu “khè khè”.
en: The white muscovy ducks waddle forward, one flaps its wings, they bob their heads and hiss softly, then settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: duck waddling, soft hissing and quacks.

start: Keep the same porch, floor, wall and style, but show only the two wooden posts and the bottom rail, with no balusters and no top rail.
vi: Từng con tiện lan can bật lên đứng vào hàng, tay vịn trên bay vào đặt lên.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the turned wooden balusters pop up one by one into a neat row, then the top handrail glides in and settles on them, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: quick wooden knocks in a rhythm.

start: Keep the same hills, trees, sky and style, but show only the wooden stilts standing on the ground, no floor, walls or roof.
vi: Trên hàng cột gỗ: sàn lắp vào, vách dựng lên, mái lá phủ xuống, cầu thang ghép vào.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: on the wooden stilts the floor slides in, the walls rise, the steep thatched roof lays itself down layer by layer and the ladder stairs fit into place, until the stilt house matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks, rustling thatch and birdsong.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the cut cassava stem stump with thin roots, no thick tubers.
vi: Rễ sắn dưới gốc phình to dần thành những củ sắn dài.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the thin roots at the cut stem swell and lengthen into the long brown cassava tubers until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft earthy creaks.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the checkered scarf fully unfolded and spread flat.
vi: Chiếc khăn rằn trải rộng tự gấp lại gọn gàng, tua rua đung đưa.
en: Folding animation from the first frame to the last: the spread-out checkered scarf folds itself neatly, once, twice, three times, and the fringe swings, until it matches the final folded scarf exactly. Sound: soft fabric swishes.

vi: Thằn lằn bò nhanh trên tường, dừng lại ngóc đầu, đuôi ngoe nguẩy.
en: The lizard scurries quickly up the wall, stops, lifts its head and flicks its tongue, its tail wiggles, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: tiny quick scratchy steps and a soft chirp.

vi: Đòn cân nghiêng lên xuống, quả cân trượt, rồi thăng bằng.
en: The scale beam tips up and down, the weight slides along the arm and swings, then the beam settles perfectly balanced in the exact original picture. Sound: metal clinks and a soft creak.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with leaves and small white plum blossoms, no fruit.
vi: Hoa mận trắng nở, kết quả mận xanh nhỏ, lớn và chín đỏ.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: white plum blossoms open on the branch, petals fall, small green plums form, swell and ripen to shiny red until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and falling petals.

vi: Cá thờn bơn vùi mình trong cát, đảo mắt, quẫy nhẹ, cát bay lên.
en: The flatfish wriggles on the sandy bottom, its two eyes roll and look around, it flaps its fins and a puff of sand rises, then it settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: underwater bubbles and soft sand swish.

vi: Chồn ngóc đầu nhìn quanh, vẫy đuôi xù, rồi nằm lại.
en: The weasel lifts its head and looks around alertly, its bushy tail swishes, it sniffs the air, then lies back down in the exact original pose. Sound: rustling grass and a small squeak.

vi: Cô giáo đón bé từ tay mẹ, bé đạp xe ba bánh, chậu hoa đung đưa.
en: The teacher takes the toddler from the mother's arms and smiles, the little boy pedals his tricycle a bit, the flowers in the pot sway, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: children's happy chatter sounds (no words), a tricycle bell.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show three small green soapberries on their stalks.
vi: Ba quả bồ hòn xanh nhỏ lớn dần, vỏ sần lại, chín nâu.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the three small green soapberries swell round, their skin wrinkles and ripens to glossy brown until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds.

vi: Dế mèn đứng vẫy tay chào, nhún nhảy; khóm tre và bông sen đung đưa; dế gáy “ri ri”.
en: The cricket waves hello with one front leg, bobs and does a little hop, the bamboo and the lotus sway in the breeze, then the cricket chirps and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: cricket chirping 'cri-cri', rustling bamboo leaves.

vi: Nhện bò ra mép lưới, giăng thêm một sợi tơ, rồi bò về giữa; lưới rung rinh.
en: The spider crawls out along a thread, spins a new strand, then hurries back to the center of the web, the whole web trembling and glinting, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a delicate silky trembling and a soft breeze.

vi: Dế mèn rung râu, giơ càng như võ sĩ, nhảy một bước, gáy “ri ri”.
en: The cricket twitches its antennae, raises its strong front legs like a little boxer, hops forward once, chirps proudly and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: loud cricket chirping.

vi: Giun đất co duỗi bò ra khỏi đất, ngóc đầu rồi chui lại.
en: The earthworm stretches and contracts, wriggles forward out of the soil, lifts its head, then slides back into the exact original position. Sound: soft squishy soil sounds.

vi: Đàn lợn con ngủ, thở phập phồng, một con ngáy “ụt ịt”, cựa mình rồi ngủ tiếp.
en: The piglets sleep in a heap, their bellies rising and falling, one twitches its ear and snorts in its sleep, another wiggles closer, then all settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: gentle piglet snores and soft oinks.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a thin pencil-like orange stroke beginning the shape of the number, almost nothing drawn yet.
vi: Chữ số 9 tự vẽ ra theo đúng nét viết: vòng tròn trước, nét móc sau, rồi tô cam.
en: Drawing animation from the first frame to the last: the number nine draws itself stroke by stroke the way a child writes it, first the round loop then the tail curving down, then it fills with bright orange and gets its outline, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a soft marker squeak while drawing and a cheerful 'ting' at the end.

vi: Bé gái chìa que giun, đàn ngan vươn cổ đớp, bà đứng cười.
en: The girl holds out the stick with the worm, the muscovy ducks stretch their necks and peck at it eagerly, the grandmother smiles and nods, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: duck quacks and hisses, a child's giggle (no words).

vi: Bé chạy lại, bà cúi đưa quả cam, bé đón lấy cười.
en: The little girl runs the last steps to her grandmother, the grandmother bends and holds out the orange, the girl reaches for it happily, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: quick little footsteps, a happy child's laugh (no words), a gate creak.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the stalk with the leaf and a small white orange blossom, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa cam trắng nở, kết quả cam xanh nhỏ, lớn tròn và chín vàng cam.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a white orange blossom opens, a tiny green orange forms, grows round and ripens to bright orange until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and buzzing bees.

vi: Xe lam nổ máy “tành tạch”, khói phụt, rung lắc, khách ngồi trong nghiêng theo.
en: The three-wheeled taxi starts up, chugs and shakes, a puff of smoke pops from the exhaust, the passengers bounce gently, the driver honks, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a noisy put-put three-wheeler engine and a honk.

vi: Con tằm bò, gặm lá dâu, vết khuyết trên lá lớn thêm.
en: The silkworm inches along the mulberry leaf and munches, the bite mark on the leaf edge growing a little, then it settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: tiny crunchy munching.

vi: Cô Tấm cúi nhìn xuống giếng, khẽ gọi cá bống; mặt nước giếng gợn, khóm tre đung đưa.
en: Tam leans over the well with the rice bowl, the water in the well ripples as if a little fish surfaces, she smiles, the bamboo sways in the breeze, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a soft water bloop in the well, rustling bamboo (no speech).

vi: Bé rắc thóc, gà con chạy lại mổ “chiếp chiếp”, gà trống ngẩng gáy, bố vác cuốc bước về.
en: The girl scatters grain, the chicks rush in pecking and cheeping, the rooster lifts its head and crows, the father walks in with the hoe on his shoulder, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: chicks cheeping, a rooster crow, footsteps.

vi: Con ếch phồng má kêu “ộp ộp”, nhảy một cái rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The frog puffs out its throat and croaks, makes a quick hop and lands back in the exact original spot beside the straw bundle. Sound: a loud frog croak 'ribbit ribbit' and rustling straw.

vi: Com pa xoay một vòng vẽ nên vòng tròn xanh trên giấy.
en: Starting with the pencil leg lifted, the compass spins around its point and draws the blue circle on the paper in one smooth turn, ending exactly as the final illustration. Sound: the scratch of a pencil on paper and a tiny click.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with the green leaves and small green rambutans with short soft hairs.
vi: Chôm chôm xanh nhỏ lớn lên, lông dài ra, chín đỏ; một quả bóc vỏ lộ cùi trắng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small green rambutans swell and their soft hairs grow long and ripen to bright red, then one fruit's skin peels open to show the white flesh, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a juicy peel.

vi: Chiều tối, bé gái xách đèn đi về, đèn lắc lư, cửa sổ sáng dần, chim về tổ.
en: At dusk the girl walks home along the village path swinging her lantern, its little flame flickers, more windows light up, a few birds fly home over the trees, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: evening crickets, a dog barking far away, soft footsteps.

vi: Chị đan len, que đan đưa nhịp nhàng, em quấn len, ngọn đèn dầu lung linh.
en: The sister knits steadily, the needles clicking, the little brother winds the yarn ball and smiles, the oil lamp flame flickers, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: knitting needles clicking and a soft crackling lamp.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the armchair as a bare wooden frame without the blue cushions.
vi: Khung ghế gỗ trơ, đệm lưng và đệm ngồi màu xanh bay vào đặt lên, phồng lên êm ái.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the bare wooden armchair frame stands ready, then the soft blue back cushion and seat cushion float in, drop into place and puff up comfortably, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks and soft cushion 'poof'.

vi: Kem chảy giọt, bạn nhỏ nhìn thèm, liếm môi, cười khoái chí.
en: Drips of melting ice cream slide down the popsicle and drip, the boy watches with delight, licks his lips and laughs, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a tiny drip sound and a happy child's 'mmm' laugh (no words).

vi: Hai bạn hái sim bỏ vào rổ, quả sim rơi lộp độp, cành sim rung.
en: The two children pick ripe sim berries and drop them into the basket, a few berries tumble in, the bush sways, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: berries plopping into a basket, rustling leaves, happy giggles (no words).

vi: Tôm hùm vẫy râu dài, giơ càng kẹp “cách cách”, búng đuôi.
en: The lobster waves its long antennae, raises and snaps its big claws, flicks its tail, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: clacking claws and underwater bubbles.

vi: Chim mẹ cúi mớm mồi, chim non há mỏ kêu “chiếp chiếp”.
en: The mother bird leans down and feeds a worm to the chicks, the baby birds open their beaks wide and cheep, flapping tiny wings, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: loud hungry chick cheeps and a mother bird's chirp.

vi: Trên màn ảnh, thỏ chạy, sói đuổi theo; bố và bé ngồi xem cười.
en: On the cinema screen the cartoon rabbit runs and the wolf chases it, the light from the screen flickers on the audience, the father and child laugh, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: playful cartoon chase sounds and an audience laughing (no speech).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with the leaves and a cluster of tiny yellow-green lychee flowers, no fruit.
vi: Hoa vải nhỏ nở, kết trái xanh, lớn dần và chín đỏ.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: tiny lychee flowers bloom, small green fruits appear, swell round and ripen to bumpy red until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: buzzing bees and soft growing sounds.

vi: Nai mẹ cúi uống nước, nai con ngẩng tai, suối chảy róc rách.
en: The mother deer drinks from the stream, the fawns twitch their ears and one takes a few playful steps, the water flows and sparkles, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a babbling brook, birds in the forest.

vi: Đu quay xoay vòng, máy bay và tên lửa bay lên xuống, các bạn vẫy tay reo.
en: The carousel spins around, the plane and rocket seats rise and dip, the children wave and cheer, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a merry fairground whirr and children cheering (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the curved rattan chair frame without the woven seat and back.
vi: Sợi mây tự đan qua lại kín lưng ghế và mặt ghế.
en: Weaving animation from the first frame to the last: rattan strands weave themselves in and out across the bare frame, filling the back and the seat with the woven pattern until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft creaking and swishing rattan.

vi: Máy bay lướt qua mây, đèn nháy, mây trôi về phía sau.
en: The airplane glides through the sky, the clouds stream past behind it, the wing lights blink, the plane tilts slightly, then settles back to the original picture. Sound: a jet airplane engine roar.

vi: Nôi đung đưa nhè nhẹ, em bé ngủ say, thở đều, mỉm cười trong mơ.
en: The hanging cradle sways gently back and forth, the baby sleeps peacefully, breathing slowly and smiling in a dream, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: the soft creak of the swinging cradle ropes and a baby's peaceful breathing.

vi: Chim mẹ mớm mồi, ba chim non há mỏ tranh nhau.
en: The mother bird feeds the worm into one open beak, the three chicks stretch up and cheep, flapping their little wings, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: chicks cheeping loudly.

vi: Dơi vỗ cánh bay lượn một vòng qua mây.
en: The bat flaps its leathery wings and swoops in a loop past the clouds, then glides back into the exact original pose. Sound: flapping wings and tiny squeaks.

vi: Voi con lấy vòi đẩy quả bóng lăn, vẫy tai, rống nhỏ.
en: The baby elephant nudges the ball with its trunk so it rolls and bounces, flaps its big ears and gives a small happy trumpet, the ball rolls back, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a small elephant trumpet and a bouncing ball.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the bag in pieces: the bag body, the front pocket with buckle and the long strap lying apart.
vi: Túi trước bay vào gắn, quai dài vắt lên, khoá cài “tách”.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the front pocket flies onto the bag and stitches on, the long strap loops up and fastens to both sides, the buckle clicks, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: fabric swishes and a buckle click.

vi: Gà mẹ bới, cục tác gọi con, gà con chạy lại mổ.
en: The mother hen scratches the ground and clucks, the chicks run over and peck at the grain, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: hen clucking and chicks cheeping.

vi: Bạn nhỏ đẩy lá thư vào khe hòm thư, lá thư rơi vào, bạn cười.
en: The boy pushes the letter into the mailbox slot, it slides in, the little flap flips shut, he smiles happily, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: paper sliding in and a metal flap clink.

vi: Máy cày chạy, lật luống đất, hai chị em chỉ tay theo dõi.
en: The red tractor drives forward ploughing the field, turning over the soil in rows, the two sisters point and follow it with their eyes, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a rumbling tractor engine and squelching mud.

vi: Kéo khép mở “xoẹt xoẹt”, cắt một mảnh giấy rơi xuống.
en: The scissors snap open and closed a few times, cutting a small piece of paper that flutters down, then return to the exact original open position. Sound: crisp scissor snips 'snip snip'.

vi: Chào mào bay về tổ, chim non há mỏ, cánh đồng lúa gợn sóng.
en: The bulbul flies in with flapping wings and lands by the nest, the chicks open their beaks, the rice field below ripples in the wind, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: cheerful bulbul song and cheeping chicks.

vi: Con dao loé sáng một vệt dọc lưỡi.
en: A bright gleam of light slides along the blade of the knife from the handle to the tip with a little sparkle, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a soft metallic 'shing'.

vi: Bồ câu mổ thóc, ngẩng lên gù “cúc cu”.
en: The pigeon pecks at the grain a few times, lifts its head, puffs its chest and coos, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pigeon cooing 'coo-coo' and pecking.

vi: Trâu gặm cỏ, bé gái vẫy tay, xa xa người cày ruộng.
en: The buffalo munches grass and swishes its tail, the girl on its back waves her hand, the farmer in the distance ploughs a few steps, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: munching, a buffalo low 'moo', a child's happy shout (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small green areca flower spike, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa cau nở, kết quả cau non, lớn dần thành quả cau thuôn.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: tiny areca flowers open, a small green nut forms and grows into the smooth oval areca fruit with its little cap until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds.

start: Keep the same ground and style, but show only the folded blue tent canvas, the poles and the stakes lying on the grass.
vi: Cọc lều cắm xuống, bạt căng lên, dây néo kéo căng, lá cờ phất lên đỉnh.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the poles stand up, the blue canvas unfolds and stretches over them, the stakes tap into the ground and the guy ropes pull tight, then the little flag pops up on top, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: canvas flapping, stakes tapping, a flag flutter.

vi: Đàn sếu vỗ cánh bay ngang trời, bông lau phất phơ.
en: The cranes beat their wings and fly across the sky in formation, the reeds below sway and bob in the wind, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: crane calls and wind in the reeds.

vi: Bé chỉ tay lên cây, một quả lựu đung đưa, chim nhỏ bay qua.
en: The boy points up excitedly at the pomegranates, a ripe one sways on its branch, the leaves rustle and a little bird flits past, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, birdsong, a child's excited 'oh' (no words).

vi: Chiếc rìu bổ xuống khúc gỗ (ngoài khung), mảnh gỗ văng, rồi về như cũ.
en: The axe swings down in an arc as if chopping, a few wood chips fly up, then it swings back to the exact original position. Sound: a strong 'thunk' of an axe into wood.

vi: Cừu lắc bộ lông xoăn, kêu “be be”.
en: The fluffy sheep shakes its curly wool, takes a step, turns its head and bleats, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a sheep bleat 'baa' and soft steps.

vi: Mẹ lắc nia sàng gạo, hạt gạo nảy lên; võng đưa nhẹ, em bé ngủ say.
en: The mother shakes the round winnowing tray in a steady rhythm so the rice grains hop and the chaff flies off, the hammock with the sleeping baby sways gently, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rice grains rustling on bamboo, the soft creak of the hammock.

vi: Đoàn bộ đội hành quân bước đều trên đường núi.
en: The soldiers march forward in step along the mountain path, backpacks bouncing, arms swinging, a few leaves stir in the wind, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: rhythmic marching footsteps on a dirt path and mountain wind.

vi: Tắc kè bò lên thân cây, dừng lại, kêu “tắc kè… tắc kè”.
en: The tokay gecko creeps up the tree trunk, pauses, puffs its throat and calls 'to-kay, to-kay', then slides back into the exact original pose. Sound: the loud gecko call 'tokay tokay'.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small peanut plant stem with a tiny yellow flower bending to the ground, no pods.
vi: Hoa lạc vàng cắm xuống đất, củ lạc lớn dần, vỏ có vân, hai củ dính ở cuống.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small yellow peanut flower bends down, a pod forms and swells into two plump peanut shells with their net pattern, joined at the stem, until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft earthy growing sounds.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the gac vine with its leaves and a small pale yellow flower, no fruit.
vi: Hoa gấc nở, quả gấc xanh lớn dần, chín đỏ, một nửa bổ ra lộ ruột đỏ.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a gac flower opens on the vine, a small green spiky fruit forms, grows big and ripens to deep orange-red, then a half splits open to show the red seeds inside, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a juicy split.

vi: Sóc gặm hạt, vẫy đuôi xù, ngó quanh rồi gặm tiếp.
en: The squirrel nibbles quickly on the nut, its bushy tail flicks, it looks around alertly, then goes back to nibbling in the exact original pose. Sound: rapid nibbling and a squirrel chatter.

vi: Thỏ gõ cửa “cốc cốc”, nghiêng tai nghe, cửa hé mở một chút.
en: The rabbit knocks on the wooden door three times, tilts its long ears to listen, the door creaks open a crack, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: 'knock knock knock' on wood and a door creak.

vi: Từ miệng vỏ ốc vọng ra tiếng sóng biển, vài hạt cát và bong bóng bay ra.
en: Soft sea sounds seem to come from inside the seashell, a few grains of sand and tiny bubbles drift out of its opening, the shell rocks slightly, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: the whoosh of ocean waves heard inside a seashell.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the green chrysanthemum bush with many small closed buds, no open flowers.
vi: Các nụ cúc lần lượt nở bung thành bông cúc vàng.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the small green buds swell and open one after another into big golden chrysanthemums, petals curling out, until the bush matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft blooming whooshes and buzzing bees.

vi: Nắp lọ mực xoay mở, ngòi bút nhúng mực rồi rút ra, nắp đậy lại.
en: The ink bottle cap twists open and lifts, a dip pen dips into the dark blue ink and lifts out with a drop, then the cap screws back on, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a cap twisting, a little ink 'plip'.

vi: Máy xúc nâng cần, gầu xúc đất, quay rồi đổ đất xuống.
en: The excavator lowers its arm, the bucket scoops a load of earth, lifts it, turns and dumps it with a puff of dust, then returns to the exact original position. Sound: a heavy excavator engine, hydraulic whirr and falling dirt.

vi: Cô giáo trao hộp quà, bé gái đón lấy cúi đầu cảm ơn, các bạn vỗ tay.
en: The teacher hands the gift box to the girl, the girl takes it and bows politely, the classmates clap happily, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: children clapping and cheerful murmurs (no words).

vi: Sóng nhẹ vỗ vào bãi cát, cánh buồm xa trôi, cỏ lay.
en: Small waves lap onto the sandy riverbank and slide back, the distant sailboat drifts slowly, the grass on the bank sways, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: gentle lapping water and wind.

vi: Chim cắt xoay đầu nhìn, xoè cánh vỗ mạnh rồi khép lại.
en: The falcon turns its head sharply to look around, spreads its wings wide and beats them powerfully, then folds them and settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a sharp falcon cry and wing beats.

vi: Gió thổi, đôi tất đung đưa trên dây phơi, kẹp giữ chặt.
en: A breeze blows and the striped socks swing and twirl on the clothesline, the line bounces, the leaves flutter, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: wind and a soft flapping of fabric.

vi: Máy cày cày ruộng lúc mặt trời lên, đàn chim bay ngang.
en: The tractor ploughs forward turning the soil at sunrise, the sun rises a little and glows, a flock of birds flies across the sky, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a tractor engine and morning birds.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a few bamboo strips lying in a loose bundle, nothing woven yet.
vi: Những nan tre tự đan chéo nhau thành cái sọt tròn.
en: Weaving animation from the first frame to the last: the bamboo strips rise and weave themselves in a crisscross pattern, round and round, forming the round basket until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft bamboo creaks and swishes.

vi: Vợt quơ một vòng, chú bướm bay vào lưới rồi bay ra.
en: The butterfly net swoops in an arc, a little butterfly flutters into the net and then flies out again, and the net swings back to the exact original position. Sound: a swish of the net and fluttering wings.

vi: Lá cờ trên đỉnh cột cờ tung bay, mây trôi.
en: The red flag on top of the brick flag tower waves strongly in the wind, the clouds drift across the sky, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a flag flapping in the wind.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only two small carrot leaf tufts on top of the soil line, no carrots visible.
vi: Củ cà rốt dưới đất lớn dần, rồi nhổ lên lộ hai củ cam dài.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the carrots grow long under the soil beneath the leafy tops, then pop up out of the ground and lie down as the two long orange carrots in the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft earthy growing and a 'pop' as they come out.

start: Keep the same branch, leaves and style, but show only a few tiny green honey-locust pods, no long dark pods.
vi: Quả bồ kết non xanh dài ra, cong lại và chín đen bóng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small green pods lengthen, curve and ripen to glossy dark brown-black until they match the final illustration exactly, swaying on the branch. Sound: soft rustling leaves.

vi: Chợ hoa Tết nhộn nhịp: người đi lại, đèn lồng đung đưa, cành đào rung nhẹ.
en: The Tet flower market bustles: people walk and browse, a woman lifts a pot of kumquat, the red lanterns sway, peach blossom petals flutter, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a lively market hum and footsteps (no clear speech).

vi: Vẹt nghiêng đầu, cúi uống nước, vỗ cánh kêu “ke ke”.
en: The parrot tilts its head, dips its beak into the cup to drink, then flaps its wings and squawks cheerfully, returning to the exact original pose. Sound: parrot squawks and a little water sip.

vi: Vịt bơi, rỉa lông, ngẩng đầu kêu “cạp cạp”, nước gợn.
en: The duck paddles on the water, preens a feather, lifts its head and quacks, ripples spread around it, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: duck quacks 'quack quack' and paddling water.

vi: Bút bi bấm “tách”, tự viết một nét nguệch ngoạc rồi nét mờ đi.
en: The ballpoint pen clicks, lifts and scribbles a little loop on the paper, the loop fades away, and the pen settles back to the exact original position. Sound: a pen click and a quick scribble.

vi: Gói mứt xoay nhẹ, hai đầu giấy xoắn bung ra rồi xoắn lại, lấp lánh.
en: The candy wrapper twists: both ends untwist a little with a crinkle, a soft sparkle glints, then they twist back tightly to the exact original picture. Sound: crinkly candy wrapper.

vi: Bạn nhỏ vẽ, con tàu trong tranh chạy, khói phụt ra.
en: The boy dabs his brush on the canvas, and the steam train in his painting comes alive, chugging along the rails and puffing smoke, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a brush stroke and a tiny train 'choo-choo'.

vi: Hai bạn chạy đuổi nhau, hoa trắng rơi, chim bay.
en: The two children run and chase each other happily, white blossoms drift down from the tree, the swallows dart across the sky, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: running footsteps, children's laughter (no words) and birds.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small young cabbage with a few open leaves, no tight head.
vi: Bắp cải non cuộn lá từng lớp, lớn tròn thành bắp.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the young leaves curl inward layer by layer, the head grows round and firm and the outer leaves spread until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft leafy rustling.

vi: Cá mập lao lên khỏi sóng, há miệng đớp “phập”, sóng tung trắng xoá.
en: The shark surges through the waves, snaps its jaws shut with a chomp, white spray flies, then it opens its mouth again into the exact original pose. Sound: crashing waves and a big 'chomp'.

vi: Các bạn gõ sào nhịp nhàng, hai bạn nhảy sạp qua lại.
en: The kneeling children clap the bamboo poles together in rhythm while the two dancers hop nimbly in and out between them, the flowers above sway, then everyone settles back to the original picture. Sound: rhythmic bamboo clacks 'clack-clack' and happy cheers (no words).

vi: Bánh xe quay, bàn đạp quay, chuông kêu “kính coong”.
en: The bicycle's pedals and wheels turn by themselves, the front basket bounces, the bell rings, then it settles back to the exact original picture. Sound: a bicycle bell 'ring ring' and a chain clicking.

vi: Bé ngồi dậy vươn vai, ngoài sân gà trống gáy, trâu vẫy đuôi.
en: The girl sits up in bed, stretches her arms with a big yawn, outside the rooster crows and the buffalo swishes its tail, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a rooster crow, a yawn (no words), morning birds.

vi: Hổ trên tảng đá gầm vang, quất đuôi.
en: The tiger on the rock roars mightily, its whiskers trembling and its tail lashing, then closes its mouth and opens it back into the exact original pose. Sound: a powerful tiger roar.

vi: Tia chớp loé, sấm rền, mưa gió quật cây.
en: A bright lightning bolt flashes from the dark cloud, the rain pours harder, the tree bends further in the wind and springs back, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a loud thunderclap rumble, heavy rain and howling wind.

vi: Ba bạn cầm sách hát, đung đưa theo nhịp (tiếng hát không lời).
en: The three children hold their songbooks and sway together in rhythm as if singing, mouths opening and closing, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful children's humming melody without words.

vi: Cá chép quẫy đuôi xoè, bơi uốn lượn, râu ngoe nguẩy.
en: The carp swishes its big fan tail, swims in a graceful curve, its whiskers waving, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: gentle water swishes and bubbles.

vi: Hai chiếc đèn lồng lắc lư, ánh nến bên trong toả sáng, tua đung đưa.
en: The two paper lanterns sway on the pole, a warm candle glow lights up inside them, the tassels swing, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: soft paper rustling and a gentle breeze.

vi: Đôi dép nhảy lên lạch bạch như đang bước đi rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The pair of rubber sandals hop forward one after the other as if walking, slapping softly on the ground, then step back to the exact original position. Sound: rubber sandals flip-flopping.

start: Keep exactly the same composition, paper background, pond water line, colors and hand-drawn ink style, but remove the lotus completely (no stem, no leaf, no bud): only calm pond water with a few small ripples where the lotus will grow.
vi: Mầm sen nhú khỏi mặt nước, thân vươn, lá xoè, nụ hồng hiện ra.
en: Time-lapse growth animation from the first frame to the last: a tiny green lotus shoot pushes up out of the calm pond water, the long stem grows taller, a big round leaf unfolds, then a small bud forms and slowly swells and blushes pink until the image matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: gentle water ripples and soft rustling of growth.

vi: Đầm sen: gió thổi lá sen rung, nụ sen nở, chuồn chuồn bay, mây trôi.
en: A breeze sweeps the lotus pond, the big leaves sway and a bud opens into a flower, a dragonfly zips across, clouds drift, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: wind over water, a dragonfly buzz and frogs far away.

start: Keep the same river, banks and style, but show only the stone bridge pillars standing in the water, no steel arches and no deck.
vi: Từ những trụ cầu, các nhịp vòm sắt lần lượt nối sang, mặt cầu trải ra thành cây cầu.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: from the stone pillars the steel arch spans swing into place one by one and the deck lays across them, until the bridge matches the final illustration exactly, the river flowing below. Sound: metallic clanks and flowing water.

vi: Xe tải, xe buýt, xe máy, xe đạp và người gánh hàng đi qua cầu, thuyền trôi dưới sông.
en: The truck, bus, motorbikes, bicycles and the woman with the carrying pole all move across the bridge, the little boat drifts on the river below, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: traffic hum, a bicycle bell, a horn and flowing water.

vi: Gà trống vỗ cánh, vươn cổ gáy “ò ó o”.
en: The rooster flaps its wings, puffs its chest, stretches its neck up and crows loudly, does a little hop on the spot, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud, clear rooster crow and wing flaps.

vi: Lợn ngủ trên ổ rơm, thở phì phò, ngáy “khò khò”, vểnh tai.
en: The plump pig sleeps on the straw, its belly rising and falling, it snores and snuffles, twitches an ear and smiles in its sleep, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: pig snores and soft grunts 'oink'.

vi: Mèo liếm chân, rửa mặt, kêu “meo” nhẹ.
en: The cat licks its paw and wipes its face, shakes its head and gives a soft 'meow', then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a gentle cat meow and soft licking.

start: Keep the same paper background, pot, grass and flowers and style, but show the plant as an untrimmed, round, shaggy green bush with leaves sticking out everywhere, no bird shape yet.
vi: Bụi cây xù trong chậu được kéo vô hình tỉa dần, lá vụn bay, hiện thành con chim; chim lá rung mình như vừa sống dậy.
en: Shaping animation from the first frame to the last: invisible garden shears snip around the shaggy bush, little leaves fly off, and the bird shape appears bit by bit, head, beak and tail, until it matches the final illustration exactly; then the leafy bird gives a tiny ruffle as if alive. Sound: crisp shear snips, falling leaves and one soft chirp.

start: Keep the same paper background, leaves and style, but show only the stem with the green leaves and the small white flower, no peppers yet.
vi: Hoa ớt trắng nở, hai quả ớt non nhú ra và dài dần; một quả chín đỏ dần, quả kia vẫn xanh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small white flower opens, two tiny green chili peppers appear and grow long and glossy, then one of them slowly ripens from green to bright red while the other stays green, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft gentle growing sounds and a light pop.

vi: Chim nhỏ nhảy dọc tấm ván, bập bênh nghiêng lên xuống, chim vỗ cánh rồi đậu lại chỗ cũ.
en: The little bird hops along the wooden seesaw, the board tips down on its side and up again, the bird flaps and rides the bounce, then the seesaw settles and the bird lands back exactly in its original spot. Sound: a wooden creak, cheerful chirps and fluttering wings.

vi: Hai bạn bước đi trên cầu, nước kênh lăn tăn, hàng dừa đung đưa, một chú cá nhảy lên khỏi mặt nước.
en: The two children walk across the little wooden bridge with a swing in their steps, the canal water ripples and sparkles, the coconut palms sway, a small fish leaps out of the water with a splash, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: footsteps on wood, flowing water, a splash and birdsong (no words).

vi: Cậu học sinh vui vẻ bước đi, tay vẫy, cặp nảy nhẹ trên lưng, chim hót, lá rung.
en: The schoolboy marches happily in place, swinging his arms, his backpack bouncing on his back, he gives a cheerful wave and smile, leaves sway and a bird flies past, then he returns to the exact original pose. Sound: light footsteps, birdsong and a happy little hum (no words).

vi: Lửa trong lò bập bùng, khói bốc cuộn lên, người thợ đặt thêm một viên gạch lên chồng.
en: The fire inside the brick kiln flickers and glows, thick smoke puffs and curls up from the roof, the worker lifts one more brick and sets it on the stack with a tap, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: crackling fire, a brick clack and a rooster far away.

vi: Mẹ quét gọn đống lá, bé rửa chiếc bát, bọt xà phòng nổi lên, nước bắn tung toé nhẹ.
en: The mother sweeps with the straw broom and the little pile of leaves swirls away, the girl scrubs the bowl in the basin and soap bubbles float up and pop, then both settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: broom swishes, splashing water and popping bubbles.

vi: Hai chú chim chích hót ríu rít, nhảy trên cành tre; hai chị em chỉ trỏ cười thích thú.
en: The two little warblers chirp back and forth, hop along the bamboo branch and flutter their wings, the bamboo leaves sway, the two sisters point and smile with delight, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: lively warbler twittering and rustling bamboo.

vi: Ếch phồng túi kêu ộp ộp, nhảy một cú rồi đáp lại đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The spotted frog puffs out its throat and croaks twice, then crouches and makes a big jump, landing back exactly in its original spot and pose; the grass and flowers wiggle. Sound: loud frog croaks ribbit ribbit and a soft landing thump.

vi: Gió thổi, các tờ lịch lật phần phật; mặt trời trong tranh lịch nhô lên rồi tờ lịch trở lại như cũ.
en: A breeze blows and the pages of the wall calendar flutter and flip up one after another, the little sun in the calendar picture rises over the hills, then the pages fall back and it settles into the exact original picture. Sound: paper pages flapping and a soft breeze.

vi: Đồng hồ báo thức reo, rung lắc; bé ngẩng lên mỉm cười rồi lại chăm chú viết bài.
en: The alarm clock rings and shakes on the little table, its bells trembling, the girl looks up at it with a smile, then turns back and keeps writing carefully in her notebook, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a ringing alarm clock and a pencil scratching on paper.

vi: Chiếc xẻng tự xúc một nhát đất, hất đất lên rồi trở về đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The shovel comes alive: it digs into a small mound of soil that appears below it, scoops up a load, tosses the soil in a little arc, then the soil disappears and the shovel returns to the exact original position. Sound: a metal blade crunching into soil and falling dirt.

vi: Trang sách lật nhẹ, cái cây và bông hoa vẽ trong sách đung đưa, một con bướm bay ra khỏi trang rồi bay về.
en: The open book's pages flutter, the little tree and flowers drawn on the pages come alive and sway, a small butterfly flies out of the page, circles and flies back into the picture, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft page rustling and a gentle magical chime.

vi: Mẹ cúi đỡ, xoa đầu gối cho bé; bé mếu rồi nín, mỉm cười với mẹ.
en: The mother gently strokes the boy's knee and holds his arm, the boy sniffles, then looks up and smiles at her, the leaves sway in the breeze, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft sniffle, a gentle comforting shh (no words) and birdsong.

start: Keep the same bamboo stalks, ground, grass and style, but show only a tiny pointed bamboo shoot tip just peeking out of the soil next to the bamboo.
vi: Đỉnh măng nhú khỏi đất, măng lớn dần, bẹ măng xếp lớp, vươn cao thành búp măng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the tiny bamboo shoot tip pushes up out of the soil, grows taller and fatter, its sheath layers unfolding one over another, until it matches the big pointed bamboo shoot in the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft earthy cracking and rustling bamboo leaves.

start: Keep the same trees, ground, sky and style, but show only the low concrete foundation of the building with no floors above it yet.
vi: Toà nhà mọc lên từng tầng, cửa sổ hiện dần, ban công gắn vào, đến khi thành nhà cao tầng.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: on the foundation the building rises floor by floor, windows and balconies appear on each new level, the roof caps the top, until the tall building matches the final illustration exactly; the trees in front sway. Sound: quick construction knocks and clinks, then birdsong.

vi: Cô giáo dẫn hàng học sinh bước đều, khăn quàng bay nhẹ, hàng cây đung đưa; trang nghiêm, nhẹ nhàng.
en: Calm and respectful: the teacher leads the line of pupils forward in neat, quiet steps, their red scarves flutter gently, the trees on both sides sway in the breeze, then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. The building stays exactly as drawn. Sound: soft footsteps and a light breeze, no music.

vi: Ba quả bóng bay bồng bềnh, chạm nhẹ vào nhau, dây nơ đung đưa.
en: The three balloons float and bob up and down, sway on their strings and gently bump into each other, the ribbon bow swings, then they return to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbery squeaks and a light breeze.

start: Keep the same paper background, stem, leaves, small side bud and style, but show the main rose as a tight closed bud, no open petals.
vi: Nụ hồng hé dần, từng lớp cánh đỏ xoè ra thành bông hồng nở to.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the closed rose bud slowly loosens and opens, red petals unfurl layer by layer from the outside in, until the full rose matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble gently. Sound: a soft gentle rustle and a tiny sparkle.

vi: Đoàn tàu chạy qua cầu sắt xình xịch, thuyền nhỏ chèo trên sông, nước chảy, mây trôi.
en: The train rolls across the long steel bridge with a rhythmic clatter, the little boat rows along the river with ripples behind it, the water flows and the clouds drift, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: train wheels clacking on the bridge, a train horn and flowing water.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show green dong leaves laid flat and open in a square with a heap of white sticky rice and green mung beans in the middle, and loose bamboo strings lying beside it.
vi: Lá dong gấp lại bọc gạo đỗ thành khối vuông, lạt tre tự vòng quanh buộc chặt thành bánh chưng.
en: Wrapping animation from the first frame to the last: the flat dong leaves fold up around the sticky rice and beans, corner by corner, into a neat square, then the bamboo strings wrap around it and tie themselves tight, until the banh chung matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: rustling leaves and the creak of strings tightening.

vi: Hoa súng hé nở rộng thêm, lá súng dập dềnh, chuồn chuồn bay lướt, mặt nước gợn sóng.
en: The water lilies open a little wider, the round lily pads bob on the gentle ripples, a dragonfly zips across and touches the water, a small fish ripple spreads, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft lapping water, a dragonfly buzz and frogs far away.

vi: Các bạn nắm tay múa vòng tròn, bạn đánh trống tùng tùng, đèn ông sao đung đưa, trăng sáng tỏa.
en: The children hold hands and dance around in a circle, the boy beats the drum, the star lanterns sway and glow, the full moon shines brighter, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a festive drum tung tung, children's happy laughter and cheerful humming (no words).

vi: Cô gái hái thêm một bông sen, thuyền thúng chòng chành, nước lăn tăn, chuồn chuồn bay qua.
