en: The girl in the round basket boat reaches out and picks a lotus flower, the basket boat rocks gently, ripples spread over the pond, the lotus leaves sway and a dragonfly flies past, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft water lapping, a paddle splash and a dragonfly buzz.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but show only a few short green sugarcane shoots with small leaves poking up from the soil, no tall stalk yet.
vi: Mầm mía nhú lên, thân mía vươn cao từng đốt, lá dài xoè ra đến khi thành khóm mía.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the short sugarcane shoots push up, the stalk grows tall joint by joint, the long leaves spread and arch out, until it matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves rustle in the wind. Sound: wooden creaks of growing cane and rustling leaves.

vi: Rùa chậm rãi bò vài bước, thụt đầu vào mai rồi thò ra, chớp mắt.
en: The turtle slowly crawls a few steps forward, pulls its head into its shell, then pokes it back out and blinks, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: soft shuffling on the ground and a tiny contented sigh.

start: Keep the same paper background, vine leaves, tendril and style, but show only the green vine with leaves and a small yellow flower, no watermelon and no slice yet.
vi: Hoa dưa nở, quả dưa nhỏ lớn tròn, vỏ sọc hiện dần; rồi một miếng dưa tách ra, ruột đỏ hạt đen.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small yellow flower opens, a tiny striped melon appears and swells into the big round watermelon, then a slice splits off and falls open showing the juicy red flesh and black seeds, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a juicy crack.

vi: Đèn trên mũ quét ánh sáng, người thợ bổ cuốc chim vào vách than, than vụn rơi, xe goòng lăn nhẹ.
en: The miner's helmet lamp sweeps its beam across the coal wall, he swings the pickaxe and strikes the coal, a few black chunks tumble down with tiny sparks, the mine cart behind rolls a little, then he returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a pickaxe clink, falling coal and an echo in the tunnel.

vi: Cô diễn viên đi trên dây, chao nhẹ rồi giữ thăng bằng; khán giả nín thở rồi vỗ tay.
en: The tightrope walker steps carefully along the rope, wobbles a little and balances with the pole, the audience holds its breath and then claps, the striped tent flags flutter, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a circus drum roll, a gasp and applause (no words).

start: Keep the same folded card shape, paper background and style, but show the card completely plain and blank, with no flowers and no border decoration.
vi: Tấm thiếp trơn tự hiện viền trang trí, cành hoa vẽ dần và nở trên thiếp.
en: Drawing animation from the first frame to the last: on the plain folded card the scalloped border draws itself around the edge, then the flower branches sketch themselves in ink, bloom and fill with soft colors, until the card matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a soft pen scratch and a gentle sparkle chime.

vi: Chú voi đá quả bóng, khỉ đạp xe vòng quanh, chú hề tung hứng; khán giả vỗ tay cười vui.
en: The elephant kicks the ball and it bounces, the monkey pedals the little bicycle around, the clown waves and juggles, the children in the audience clap and laugh, then everyone returns to the exact original picture. Sound: cheerful circus music, a bicycle bell, an elephant trumpet and children laughing (no words).

vi: Bóng đèn tắt rồi bật sáng rực, chao đèn đung đưa nhẹ, một con thiêu thân bay vòng quanh.
en: The light bulb flickers off and then switches on bright, its warm rays spreading out, the lamp shade sways gently on its cord, a little moth flutters around the light, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a light switch click and a soft electric hum.

vi: Tàu đánh cá rẽ sóng, cờ bay phần phật, hải âu lượn kêu, ngư dân vẫy tay.
en: The fishing boat ploughs through the waves throwing white spray, its flag snaps in the wind, the seagulls glide and call overhead, the fishermen wave, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a chugging boat engine, splashing waves and seagull cries.

vi: Ngựa gặm cỏ, ngẩng đầu hí, lắc bờm, vẫy đuôi, giậm chân rồi lại cúi ăn cỏ.
en: The horse munches the grass, lifts its head and neighs, shakes its mane, swishes its tail and stamps a hoof, then lowers its head to graze again in the exact original pose. Sound: a horse neighing, munching grass and a hoof stamp.

vi: Hộp diêm tự mở rộng ra, một que diêm quẹt bùng lửa nhỏ rồi tắt, khói mỏng bay lên, hộp đóng lại.
en: The matchbox drawer slides open a little more, one match lifts out and strikes the side, a small flame flares up and flickers, then it puffs out with a thin curl of smoke and the match settles back, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a match strike scratch, a soft whoosh of flame and a little puff.

vi: Bé đặt thêm khối gỗ lên tháp, quả bóng lăn tới, bé cười vỗ tay, nơ tóc rung rinh.
en: The little girl places one more wooden block on her tower, the striped ball rolls toward her, she laughs and claps her hands, her hair ribbons bounce, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: wooden blocks clacking and a happy little giggle (no words).

vi: Đàn kiến nối đuôi nhau bò về tổ, khiêng chiếc lá và con châu chấu, râu ngọ nguậy.
en: The line of ants marches toward the anthill, carrying the leaf and the grasshopper together, their little legs and antennae wiggling busily, one ant goes into the hole and another comes out, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: tiny busy pitter-patter and rustling grass.

vi: Mưa gió quất mạnh, mây đen vần vũ, cò trắng vỗ cánh bay qua cánh đồng, lúa rạp theo gió.
en: Wind and rain sweep across the field, the dark clouds churn, the white stork beats its wings and glides through the rain, the rice plants and palm trees bend in the gusts, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: heavy rain, gusting wind, far thunder and wings flapping.

vi: Cánh diều chao lượn trong gió, đuôi diều uốn lượn, mây trôi, sáo diều vi vu.
en: The kite swoops and dips in the wind, its colorful tail ribbons ripple and curl, the string tugs, the clouds drift past, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: wind and a humming kite flute vi vu.

vi: Cô giáo cầm tay bé viết từng nét, bé ngẩng lên cười; các bạn chăm chú viết bài.
en: The teacher gently guides the boy's hand as he writes a stroke, he looks up and smiles at her, the other pupils keep writing carefully, the window leaves sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pencils scratching on paper and soft birdsong outside.

vi: Mẹ ôm bé đung đưa ru nhẹ, bé dụi đầu vào mẹ cười, mẹ hôn lên tóc bé.
en: The mother hugs the baby and rocks gently from side to side, the baby snuggles into her and smiles, she kisses the baby's hair, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft humming lullaby (no words) and a baby's happy coo.

vi: Cậu bé chăm chú viết từng nét, ngẩng lên nhìn vở hài lòng, rồi viết tiếp.
en: The boy writes carefully in his notebook stroke by stroke, pauses to look at his work with a proud little smile, then bends down and keeps writing, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a pen scratching on paper and a soft tick of a clock.

vi: Chim yểng ngoẹo đầu, há mỏ hót líu lo, xù lông, nhún nhảy trên cành.
en: The black hill myna tilts its head, opens its yellow beak and whistles a lively tune, fluffs its glossy feathers and bobs on the branch, the leaves tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud cheerful myna whistle and chatter.

vi: Các bạn chụm đầu thì thầm rủ rê, cậu bé lắc đầu quay đi, đứng vững chống nạnh.
en: The group of children huddle and whisper, one beckons with a hand, the boy shakes his head firmly and turns his face away, standing tall with his hands on his hips, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: soft whispering murmurs (no words) and a firm little 'hmph'.

start: Keep the same paper background, leaves and style, but show only one small green spiky durian on its stalk, closed, no open half yet.
vi: Quả sầu riêng nhỏ lớn dần, gai nhọn mọc dày, rồi một quả nứt ra lộ múi vàng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small durian swells big and round, its sharp spikes growing thick, a second durian appears beside it, then it cracks open along the seams to reveal the creamy yellow pods, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a woody crack.

vi: Cậu bé kéo dây, cánh diều bay cao lượn vòng, đuôi diều tung bay, hàng cau đung đưa.
en: The boy tugs the string and the kite climbs higher and loops in the wind, its tail ribbons fluttering, he looks up with a big smile, the palm trees and grass sway, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: wind and a humming kite flute.

vi: Cánh buồm căng gió, thuyền nhấp nhô trên sóng, lá cờ bay phần phật, mây trôi.
en: The white sail fills and billows in the wind, the boat rises and dips on the waves, the little flag snaps at the top of the mast, the clouds drift, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: flapping canvas, splashing waves and wind.

vi: Cào cào nhảy tanh tách, ba bạn nhào tới chụp, cào cào nhảy thoát, các bạn cười vang.
en: The grasshoppers spring away in little hops, the three children lunge and cup their hands to catch them, the grasshoppers leap free, the children laugh, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: chirping grasshoppers, rustling grass and children's laughter (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background, banana leaf and style, but show only a hanging purple banana flower bud on its thick stem, no bananas yet.
vi: Bắp chuối hé ra, nải chuối xanh nhú lên, quả cong dài ra rồi chín vàng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the purple banana flower bud opens its petals, small green fingers of bananas appear in a hand, grow long and curved and ripen from green to bright yellow, until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and rustling leaves.

vi: Chiếc cuốc tự bổ xuống đất, xới lên tơi xốp, đất văng nhẹ rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The hoe comes alive: it lifts up, chops down into the soil and pulls back, turning over a clump of loose brown earth with a few crumbs flying, then returns to the exact original position. Sound: a thud of the hoe into soil and crumbling earth.

vi: Các bạn nắm tay chạy vòng tròn, bạn làm mèo đuổi bạn làm chuột luồn qua tay, cả nhóm cười vang.
en: The children holding hands circle around, the child playing the cat chases the child playing the mouse who ducks under the joined arms, everyone laughs and cheers, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: running footsteps and happy children's laughter (no words).

vi: Cô đạp máy tuốt lúa, trống quay vù vù, hạt thóc bay ra rổ; cô kia đưa bó lúa vào.
en: The woman pumps the pedal and the threshing drum spins, golden grains spray into the basket, the other woman feeds a sheaf of rice into the machine, straw bits fly, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a rhythmic whirring thresher and pattering grain.

vi: Quả chuông lắc qua lắc lại, quả lắc gõ vào thân, tiếng chuông ngân vang, sóng âm toả ra.
en: The bronze bell swings from side to side on its hanger, the clapper strikes inside, faint ripples of sound spread out in the air, then the bell slows and settles back into the exact original position. Sound: a deep ringing bell dong dong with a long echo.

vi: Chuồn chuồn rung cánh, bay lên lượn trên mặt nước, chạm nước rồi đậu lại đúng ngọn cỏ.
en: The dragonfly flickers its wings, lifts off and darts over the water, dips and touches the surface making a small ripple, then flies back and lands exactly on the same grass blade in the original pose. Sound: a light dragonfly buzz and gentle water.

vi: Hai con vịt kêu cạp cạp, bơi tới bơi lui, một con lặn đầu xuống; cá nhỏ quẫy đuôi bơi đi.
en: The two ducks quack, paddle around and one dips its head underwater, the little fish flick their tails and swim away, ripples spread, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: ducks quacking quack quack and splashing water.

vi: Mèo leo tiếp lên cây cau, vẫy đuôi; chú chuột đội nón xách giỏ chạy lon ton ra khỏi nhà.
en: The cat climbs a little higher up the areca trunk, flicks its tail and looks down, the little mouse in the conical hat trots off with its basket, swinging it happily, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: claws scratching bark, a soft meow and tiny pattering feet.

vi: Hươu sao vểnh tai, quay đầu, cúi ăn cỏ, vẫy đuôi rồi đứng lại như cũ.
en: The spotted deer twitches its ears, turns its head, bends down to nibble the grass, flicks its short tail, then lifts its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: rustling grass, a soft deer call and birdsong.

vi: Đàn hươu uống nước, gặm cỏ; suối chảy róc rách, chim đậu trên cành hót.
en: The deer dip their heads to drink from the stream and nibble the grass, one lifts its head and looks around, the stream flows and sparkles, the bird on the branch sings, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a babbling stream, a bird song and soft lapping.

start: Keep the same paper background, stalk, leaves and style, but show only a small white pomelo blossom on the stalk among the leaves, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa bưởi trắng nở, quả bưởi nhỏ hiện ra, lớn tròn căng và chuyển vàng xanh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the white pomelo blossom opens, its petals fall, a tiny green pomelo forms and swells into the big round fruit, turning yellow-green, until it matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble. Sound: soft growing sounds and a light breeze.

vi: Cậu bé trượt vèo xuống cầu trượt, tay giơ cao reo; bạn gái trên cao cười, chuẩn bị trượt.
en: The boy whooshes down the slide with his arms up cheering, the girl at the top laughs and gets ready to slide, the leaves sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a whoosh down the slide and children's happy shouts (no words).

vi: Các bạn rước đèn đi đều, đèn ông sao xoay, đèn cá đung đưa, ánh nến lung linh, trăng sáng.
en: The children parade forward with their lanterns, the star lantern turns, the fish lantern sways, the candle lights flicker and glow, the full moon shines, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a festive drum, footsteps and children's cheerful humming (no words).

vi: Ca nô lao trên mặt hồ, nước tung trắng, người trên ván lướt nhún người, rẽ sóng.
en: The speedboat races across the lake throwing white spray, the person on the water ski crouches and leans, carving through the wake, the rope tightens, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a buzzing outboard motor and rushing splashing water.

vi: Bướm vỗ đôi cánh to, chao lượn lên xuống rồi về đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The butterfly flaps its big patterned wings, flutters up and down in a gentle dance, then glides back and settles into the exact original position with wings spread. Sound: soft fluttering and a light breeze.

vi: Mặt hồ gợn sóng, người đi dạo, xe đạp chạy qua, hoa phượng rơi; Tháp Rùa giữ nguyên.
en: Calm and gentle: the lake water ripples and sparkles, the strolling people walk along the path, the cyclist rides past, a few red flowers drift down from the tree, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The tower in the lake stays exactly as drawn. Sound: soft lapping water, a bicycle bell and birdsong.

start: Keep the same bamboo trellis, vine leaves, tendrils and style, but show only the yellow luffa flowers on the vine, no gourds yet.
vi: Hoa mướp vàng nở, quả mướp non thõng xuống, dài ra và căng mọng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the yellow luffa flowers open, tiny green gourds appear beneath them, hang down and grow long and plump with their ridges, until they match the final illustration exactly; the tendrils curl. Sound: soft rustling growth and a light breeze.

vi: Vượn đánh đu trên cành, chuyền sang rồi đu lại, kêu hú, cành cây rung rinh.
en: The gibbon swings on the branch by one long arm, swings out and back, gives a playful call, the branch and leaves bounce, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a gibbon whooping call and rustling leaves.

vi: Bé chải tóc, nghiêng đầu cười với gương, bóng trong gương làm theo, rồi về như cũ.
en: The girl combs her hair with long strokes, tilts her head and smiles at the mirror, her reflection copies every move exactly, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft comb swish and a happy little hum (no words).

vi: Trăng tròn sáng dần, ánh trăng lấp lánh, rừng tre đung đưa, đèn lồng lắc nhẹ, khói trà bay lên.
en: The full moon glows brighter and its light shimmers over the stilt-house porch, the bamboo grove sways, the paper lantern swings gently, a thin wisp of steam rises from the teapot, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: night crickets, rustling bamboo and a soft breeze.

vi: Cậu bé hô to vào loa, sóng âm toả ra, cậu hạ loa xuống cười rồi giơ lên như cũ.
en: The boy shouts into the megaphone, little sound-wave lines burst out of it, he lowers it with a big grin and then raises it back to his mouth in the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful amplified shout 'ơ' (no words) with a short echo.

vi: Chim chích choè hót líu lo, vẫy đuôi dài, nhún nhảy trên cành.
en: The magpie robin opens its beak and sings a rich melodious song, flicks its long tail up and down, bobs on the branch, the leaves tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud sweet magpie robin song.

vi: Mây trôi để lộ vầng trăng sáng, ngọn đèn bão lập loè, hai bạn quay đầu nhìn trăng rồi nhìn đèn.
en: The cloud drifts aside to reveal the bright moon, the hurricane lamp's flame flickers and glows, the two children turn their heads from the moon to the lamp and smile, then the cloud drifts back and everything settles into the exact original picture. Sound: night crickets and a soft flickering flame.

vi: Điện thoại reo, ống nghe nảy lên rung rung, dây xoắn đung đưa, rồi nằm yên lại.
en: The old telephone rings, the handset jiggles and hops on its cradle, the curly cord bounces, the rotary dial turns a little, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a classic telephone bell ring ring.

vi: Tay quay khoan tự quay tít, mũi khoan xoắn xoay tròn, vụn gỗ bay ra rồi dừng lại.
en: The hand drill's crank spins round and round by itself, the twisted drill bit beside it rotates, a few curly wood shavings fly out, then everything slows and settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a whirring hand drill and a soft wooden crunch.

vi: Má dắt bé bước đi, bé đung đưa tay; người bên ao giũ áo, nước bắn; xoài đung đưa, lá dừa lay.
en: The grandmother and the girl walk along hand in hand, swinging their arms, the woman by the pond shakes out the washing with a splash, the ripe mangoes sway on the tree and the coconut fronds wave, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, splashing water, birdsong and a rooster far away.

vi: Chú nghé vểnh tai nghe chim hót, kêu nghé ọ, bước đi; cò trắng vỗ cánh bay qua.
en: The little buffalo calf twitches its ears toward the singing bird, gives a soft moo, takes a few steps along the bamboo bank, the white egret flaps across the sky, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a calf mooing, birdsong and rustling bamboo.

vi: Mưa rơi lộp độp, hai bạn nhảy vào vũng nước té nước, giơ tay hứng mưa, cười vui.
en: Rain pours down, the two children in raincoats hop into the puddles making splashes, the girl holds out her hand to catch the drops, they laugh, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: rain pattering on raincoats, puddle splashes and happy giggles (no words).

vi: Bạn đứng phát biểu, vẫy tay; các bạn quay sang lắng nghe, gật đầu, một bạn ghi chép.
en: A friendly class group meeting: the standing pupil waves his hand cheerfully, the classmates around the table turn toward him, smile and nod, one girl writes in her notebook, the flowers in the pot sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft pencil scratch, a light breeze and happy murmurs (no words).

vi: Chú bé bước thoăn thoắt trên đường đồi, xắc nảy theo bước chân, mây trôi.
en: The little boy strides briskly along the hill road, his satchel bouncing at his side, his arms swinging, the clouds drift and the grass sways, then he returns to the exact original pose. Sound: quick light footsteps and a breeze over the hills.

vi: Một chiếc xe nhỏ chạy vòng qua chỗ ngoặt rồi khuất, mây trôi, cây lay động.
en: A tiny car drives along the winding mountain road, slows and turns around the sharp bend, then disappears behind the rock, the clouds drift and the trees sway, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a distant engine hum and a short horn beep.

vi: Bé lắc đầu, mái tóc xoăn tít nảy tưng tưng, nơ rung rinh, bé cười tươi.
en: The little girl shakes her head and her tight curls bounce like springs, her hair bow wiggles, she blinks and gives a big smile, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful little giggle (no words).

vi: Các bạn đặt thêm giấy vụn, lon sắt vào đống, đống giấy cao dần, bạn nhỏ phủi tay vui vẻ.
en: The children add more bundles of paper and tin cans to the pile, the pile grows a little taller, one girl brushes her hands and smiles, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rustling paper and clinking cans.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only one whole long uncut loaf of bread, no slices.
vi: Ổ bánh mì nguyên tự cắt thành từng khoanh, vụn bánh rơi, các khoanh ngả ra lộ ruột.
en: Slicing animation from the first frame to the last: an invisible knife cuts the whole loaf, the round slices fall away one by one and tip over to show the soft crumb, a few crumbs scatter, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a crunchy bread knife sawing and soft crumbs falling.

vi: Cô nông dân vác bó lúa bước đi, mỉm cười, khăn bay; đồng lúa vàng gợn sóng.
en: The farmer carries the sheaf of rice on her shoulder and walks a few steps with a smile, her towel flutters, the golden field ripples in the wind and the haystacks sway, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rustling rice stalks and birdsong.

vi: Con hoẵng nhảy vọt qua bụi cỏ, đáp xuống rồi lại vọt lên đúng tư thế cũ.
en: The barking deer lands from its leap, takes two springy bounds through the bushes and leaps again, ending in the exact original mid-jump pose, the grass waving behind it. Sound: light hoof thuds and rustling bushes.

vi: Người nông dân bổ cuốc xới đất, người kia phát cỏ, cỏ rụng, đất tơi lên.
en: The man swings his hoe and turns over the soil, the woman cuts the tall grass with her knife and it falls away, clods of earth tumble, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: hoe thuds, swishing grass cuts and birdsong.

vi: Hai người khiêng thúng cá bước đi, cá quẫy lấp lánh, người trên thuyền chuyển cá, sóng vỗ.
en: The two fishermen carry the basket of fish a few steps, the silvery fish flip and sparkle, the man on the boat lifts more fish, small waves lap the shore, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: waves, flapping fish and seagulls.

vi: Lá cờ lớn bay phần phật, đoàn quân xa xa phi ngựa, bụi bốc lên; nhìn từ xa, không rõ mặt.
en: The big banner flaps strongly in the wind, the distant cavalry gallops forward with flags streaming and a trail of dust, seen far away with no clear faces, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: galloping hooves, a snapping flag and a war drum in the distance.

start: Keep the same paper background, stalks, leaves and style, but show only closed white tuberose buds on the stalks, no open flowers.
vi: Các nụ huệ trắng hé nở từng bông, cánh xoè ra, nhụy hiện, đến khi thành cành hoa huệ.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the closed white tuberose buds open one by one, the petals curl back and the stamens appear, until the stalk of flowers matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves sway gently. Sound: a soft gentle rustle and a tiny sparkle.

vi: Tàu thuỷ chạy trên sông, ống khói nhả khói, kéo còi, sóng rẽ hai bên.
en: The steamship chugs along the river, puffs of smoke billow from its funnel, it sounds its horn, waves roll from its bow, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a chugging engine and a deep ship horn 'tuu'.

vi: Thuyền buồm trôi trên sông, nước gợn, mây trôi, lá cây đung đưa; công trình giữ nguyên.
en: Calm and gentle: the sailboats glide slowly down the river, the water ripples and sparkles, the clouds drift, the tree leaves sway and a few red flowers fall, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The buildings stay exactly as drawn. Sound: soft lapping water and birdsong.

vi: Tấm huân chương đung đưa nhẹ trên dải băng, một vệt sáng lấp lánh lướt qua ngôi sao.
en: The star medal swings gently on its ribbon, a bright gleam of light slides across the golden star with a sparkle, then it settles back into the exact original position. Sound: a soft metallic chime.

vi: Bạn trai xúc đất vun gốc, bạn gái giữ cây non thẳng, cây non vươn lá, các bạn phía xa trồng cây.
en: The boy shovels soil around the young tree, the girl holds it straight, the sapling sprouts a new leaf, the other children in the distance plant their trees, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: shovel scrapes, birdsong and children's happy chatter (no words).

vi: Chú voi huơ vòi lên cao, rống vang, vẫy tai, nhún chân rồi về như cũ.
en: The elephant swings its trunk high in a wavy curl, trumpets loudly, flaps its big ears and shifts its weight from foot to foot, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud elephant trumpet and heavy footsteps.

vi: Bếp lửa bập bùng, nồi bốc hơi, cả nhà quây quần cười nói, mặt trời lặn dần.
en: The fire crackles and its warm flames dance, steam rises from the pot, the family leans in and smiles together, the sun sinks a little behind the mountains, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a crackling fire, a bubbling pot and soft family murmurs (no words).

vi: Hai con cá vàng ngoe nguẩy đuôi, bơi vòng quanh bể, nhả bong bóng, rong lay động.
en: The two goldfish swish their fan tails and swim a circle around the round bowl, little bubbles float up, the water plants sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: gentle bubbling water.

vi: Máy tiện quay, phoi kim loại xoắn ra, người thợ xoay tay quay, đèn sáng.
en: The lathe spins, curly metal shavings peel off the turning part, the worker turns the handwheel carefully, the lamp glows, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a humming lathe motor and a soft metal whirr.

vi: Chim vành khuyên hót ríu rít, nghiêng đầu, nhảy nhẹ trên cành; hoa trắng rung rinh.
en: The little white-eye tilts its head, chirps a quick sweet song and hops along the branch, the white blossoms tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: high sweet twittering of a white-eye.

vi: Đoàn chiến sĩ bước đều tăm tắp, tay vung đều, lá cờ bay; trang nghiêm.
en: The soldiers march forward in perfect step, arms swinging in unison, the flag waves above them, then they return to the exact original pose. Calm and dignified. Sound: crisp rhythmic marching boots and a snapping flag.

vi: Thuyền buồm trôi giữa các đảo đá, nước gợn sóng, mây trôi, chim bay xa.
en: The junk with orange sails glides slowly between the limestone islands, the water ripples and sparkles, the clouds drift and a few birds fly far away, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft waves and a gentle sea breeze.

vi: Thuyền nhỏ trôi trên sông, đồi chè gợn gió, rừng cọ đung đưa, mây trôi trên núi.
en: The little boat drifts along the river with ripples behind it, the tea hills ripple in the breeze, the palm trees sway, clouds drift over the mountains, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: flowing water, a breeze and birdsong.

vi: Các bạn thiếu nhi cười nói vui vẻ, khăn quàng bay nhẹ, hoa trong chậu rung rinh.
en: The children laugh and lean toward each other happily, their red scarves flutter gently, the flowers in the pot sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children's laughter (no words) and birdsong.

vi: Quả địa cầu xoay tròn, các bạn giơ tay reo vui, chim bồ câu vỗ cánh bay, bóng bay bồng bềnh.
en: The globe spins around, the children wave their arms and cheer, the white doves flap and circle overhead, the balloons bob, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: children cheering (no words), flapping wings and a cheerful chime.

vi: Cờ bay phần phật, các bạn bước vào cổng trường, cây xanh lay động.
en: The flag flutters on the pole, the pupils walk through the school gate with their bags, the trees sway in the breeze, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, a school bell and birdsong.

vi: Bé giơ sách mới khoe bà, bà cúi xuống cười; mẹ sàng gạo, hạt gạo nhảy trên nong.
en: The girl holds up her new book proudly, the grandmother leans down and smiles, the mother shakes the winnowing tray and the rice grains bounce, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rustling rice grains, a soft happy laugh and chickens clucking.

vi: Nước chảy từ vòi, bé xoa tay đầy bọt xà phòng, bong bóng bay lên, hoa trên giàn rung rinh.
en: Water runs from the tap, the girl rubs her soapy hands together, bubbles float up and pop, she rinses and smiles, the flowers above sway, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: running water, splashing and popping bubbles.

vi: Chú chim cầm sách đọc to, hai bạn chim nghe, gật gù hót theo.
en: The little bird with the book chirps out loud as if reading, the two other chicks nod along and chirp back, flapping their tiny wings, the leaves sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: rhythmic cheerful chick chirping.

vi: Các bạn giơ vở mới lên khoe, cười vui, nhún nhảy nhẹ.
en: The children lift their new notebooks up proudly, laugh and bounce a little on their toes, the flowers sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children's laughter (no words) and rustling paper.

vi: Tán bàng xào xạc, lá rơi, các bạn đá bóng, bóng lăn; mấy bạn ngồi dưới gốc trò chuyện.
en: The big tree's leaves rustle and a few drift down, the children kick the ball and it rolls, the group under the tree chats and laughs, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, a ball kick and children playing (no words).

vi: Đàn thỏ nắm tay múa vòng tròn, hươu gật gù xem, sóc nhún nhảy, trăng sáng.
en: The rabbits hold hands and dance around in a circle, hopping on the beat, the deer nod along, the squirrel bounces on its branch, the moon glows, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful forest dance tune with light drum taps and crickets.

vi: Bốn bạn tung tăng đi học, túi sách nảy, tre đung đưa, trống trường xa xa.
en: The four children walk happily along the village road, their bags bouncing, they chat and laugh, the bamboo sways, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, chatter-like laughter (no words) and a school drum far away.

vi: Hai con dê lùi lại rồi húc đầu vào nhau, kêu be be, cầu rung, suối chảy.
en: The black goat and the white goat step back and butt heads together, bleating stubbornly, the narrow bridge wobbles, the stream rushes below, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: goats bleating 'be be', a horn clack and a rushing stream.

vi: Quạ thả hòn sỏi vào lọ, nước dâng lên, quạ nghiêng đầu nhìn rồi nhặt hòn khác.
en: The crow drops the pebble into the jar with a plop, the water rises a little, it tilts its head to look, then picks up another pebble, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a pebble plop into water and a crow's caw.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the same wooden pencil with a flat, unsharpened end, no point.
vi: Cây bút chì tự vót nhọn, vỏ gỗ cuộn ra, ruột chì đen lộ ra thành đầu nhọn.
en: Sharpening animation from the first frame to the last: the flat end of the pencil is shaved by an invisible blade, curly wood shavings spin off, the black lead appears and becomes a sharp point, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a crisp sharpening scrape.

vi: Cục tẩy tự chà qua lại, vụn tẩy rơi, vết bẩn mờ đi rồi tẩy về chỗ cũ.
en: The eraser rubs back and forth on the paper by itself, little eraser crumbs roll off and a pencil smudge fades away, then it returns to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbing squeaks.

vi: Cây thước tự kẻ một đường thẳng, đường kẻ hiện ra rồi mờ đi, thước về chỗ cũ.
en: The wooden ruler slides into place and a pencil line draws itself straight along its edge, the line fades away and the ruler returns to the exact original position. Sound: a smooth pencil line scratch.

vi: Hai bạn nghiêng đầu đố nhau, dấu hỏi nảy lên, bạn gái hé lộ món đồ rồi giấu lại.
en: The two children tilt their heads and grin at each other, the question marks above them bounce, the girl peeks her hidden object out from behind her back and hides it again, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a playful 'hmm' giggle (no words) and a boing for the question marks.

vi: Mẹ phe phẩy quạt, em bé ngủ ngon, chị đọc sách lật trang, mèo vẫy đuôi.
en: The mother fans gently with the paper fan, the baby sleeps peacefully and stirs a little, the sister turns a page of her book, the cat flicks its tail, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft fan whoosh, a page turn and a sleepy purr.

vi: Chị đưa võng, võng đong đưa, em bé ngủ say, chó nằm thở đều, lá rơi.
en: The girl rocks the hammock and it swings gently back and forth, the baby sleeps soundly, the dog breathes slowly in its sleep, a leaf drifts down, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a creaking hammock rope, a soft lullaby hum (no words) and birdsong.

vi: Cậu bé đưa cốc nước, bác đưa thư cười cảm ơn, chuông xe đạp kêu kính coong.
en: The boy holds out the glass of water, the postman smiles and reaches for it with a nod of thanks, the bicycle bell gives a little ring, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a bicycle bell ring and a warm chuckle (no words).

vi: Mưa rơi rào rào, hai mẹ con bước vội, gánh hàng đung đưa, nước vũng bắn lên.
en: Heavy rain pours, the mother and daughter hurry along, the carrying pole and baskets bounce and sway, water splashes from the puddles at each step, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: heavy rain, splashing footsteps and creaking carrying pole.

vi: Chuột béo giãy giụa trong khe vách, chuột kia hốt hoảng nhảy lên, vụn vữa rơi.
en: The fat mouse wriggles and kicks, stuck in the crack in the wall, the other mouse hops up and down in alarm waving its arms, a few bits of plaster fall, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: frantic squeaks and crumbling plaster.

vi: Bà phe phẩy quạt mỉm cười nghe, bé đọc truyện lật trang, mẹ khâu áo kéo chỉ.
en: The grandmother fans herself and smiles as she listens, the girl reads and turns a page, the mother pulls her needle and thread through the cloth, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft fan whoosh, a page turn and birdsong.

vi: Bé nặn đất thành con chuột, nặn xong đặt xuống nong; mèo vểnh tai, vẫy đuôi tò mò.
en: The child squeezes and shapes the clay in his hands into a little mouse and sets it on the tray, the cat perks up its ears and flicks its tail curiously, then everything returns to the exact original pose. Sound: soft squishy clay and a curious meow.

vi: Hai anh em vẫy tay chào, bố mẹ ở cửa sổ vẫy lại, cây lay động.
en: The two children wave goodbye as they set off, the parents at the window wave back and smile, the trees and flowers sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, birdsong and a happy farewell call (no words).

vi: Bé trai quạt cho mẹ, bé gái đưa bát nước, mẹ lau mồ hôi rồi mỉm cười đón bát.
en: The boy fans his mother, the girl offers the bowl of water, the mother wipes her brow and smiles as she reaches for the bowl, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft fan whoosh and a grateful sigh.

vi: Bé cúi ngửi bông hồng, bông hồng hé nở rộng hơn, bé mỉm cười, lá rung rinh.
en: The girl leans in to smell the red rose, the rose opens a little wider, she smiles happily, the leaves sway in the breeze, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a gentle sniff, a happy sigh and birdsong.

vi: Ong mật vo ve bay quanh cành đào, đậu vào bông hoa hút mật rồi bay lên.
en: The honeybee buzzes around the peach blossoms, lands on a flower, sips the nectar, then lifts off and hovers back to the exact original position. Sound: a lively bee buzz.

vi: Trâu gặm cỏ, ngẩng đầu nghé ọ, vẫy đuôi, lắc sừng rồi cúi ăn tiếp.
en: The water buffalo munches the grass, raises its head and lows, swishes its tail and shakes its horns, then lowers its head to graze again in the exact original pose. Sound: a deep buffalo low 'nghé ọ' and munching grass.

vi: Gà trống vươn cổ gáy ò ó o, vỗ cánh phành phạch trên đống rơm.
en: The rooster stretches its neck and crows loudly, flaps its wings hard on top of the straw pile, a few straws fly, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud rooster crow 'ò ó o' and flapping wings.

vi: Hai bạn hái sim bỏ vào giỏ, con diều bay lượn trên cao, đàn trâu gặm cỏ vẫy đuôi, mặt trời chiều toả nắng.
en: Summer on the hill: the two children pick ripe purple sim berries and drop them into the basket, the kite dances and swoops in the sky as the boy tugs the string, the buffaloes graze and swish their tails, the bushes sway, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a summer breeze, a fluttering kite, cicadas and a buffalo low far away.

vi: Đàn sơn ca vỗ cánh bay vút lên, lượn vòng trên trời, hoa cỏ trên đồi đung đưa, mây trôi.
en: The flock of skylarks beat their wings and soar upward, circle and glide across the sky, the grass and little orange flowers on the hillside sway in the wind, the clouds drift, then the birds return to their exact original positions. Sound: bright, joyful skylark songs and a soft wind over the hill.

vi: Người chèo thuyền chở lúa đi trên sông, nước lăn tăn, hàng dừa đung đưa, đồng lúa gợn sóng, khói bếp bay lên.
en: The boatman rows the boat loaded with rice sheaves along the winding river, ripples spread on the water, the coconut palms sway, the golden rice field ripples like waves in the wind, a thin wisp of kitchen smoke rises from the village house, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: an oar splashing, flowing water, birdsong and a breeze through the rice.

vi: Giọt nước trên lá khoai lăn xuống tách tách, gà mẹ cục cục gọi con, đàn gà con chạy lon ton mổ quanh vũng nước.
en: After the rain: water drops roll off the big taro leaves and fall with tiny plips into the puddle making little rings, the mother hen clucks and scratches the ground, the yellow chicks run around the puddle and peck, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: dripping water, a mother hen clucking and chicks peeping.

vi: Con gấu cúi ngửi mặt người nằm, người ấy nín thở nằm im; người trên cây bám chặt nhìn xuống; gấu lắc đầu bỏ đi rồi quay lại chỗ cũ.
en: The black bear sniffs the face of the man lying still on the ground, the man holds his breath and does not move, the boy up in the tree clings to the branch and peeks down, the two friends watch with worried faces, the bear shakes its head and turns away, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a bear's snuffling and a low grunt, rustling leaves and forest birds (no words).

vi: Hai chú thợ vặn ốc sửa xe tải, máy tiện quay, máy nén khí rung; các bạn chỉ trỏ, ngó nghiêng thích thú.
en: In the busy repair workshop: the two mechanics tighten bolts on the open truck engine, the lathe spins, the air compressor shudders, the lamps sway slightly, the guide points and the pupils lean forward and point with excitement, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: clinking wrenches, a humming machine and a compressor hiss (no words).

vi: Voi giơ vòi rống, tê giác lắc đầu, trâu rừng thở phì, nai ngẩng lên nghe ngóng, gấu đen lững thững bước; cây cỏ rung rinh.
en: In the Central Highlands forest: the elephant raises its trunk and trumpets, the rhinoceros shakes its head, the wild buffalo snorts and swings its horns, the deer lift their heads and twitch their ears, the black bear ambles a few steps, the tall grass and leaves sway, then all the animals return to their exact original poses. Sound: an elephant trumpet, a buffalo snort, rustling grass and jungle birds.

vi: Nước từ ống tre chảy ào xuống máng gỗ, mặt nước sóng sánh; các bạn nhỏ cười, vẫy tay, một bạn vốc nước té lên.
en: Water pours from the bamboo pipe into the wooden trough, the water surface splashes and ripples, the stream flows past the rocks, the children laugh, one dips a hand and splashes a little water, another waves the towel, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pouring and splashing water, a rushing mountain stream and children's laughter (no words).

vi: Chim sâu nghiêng đầu, mổ con sâu xanh, nhảy nhẹ trên cành; lá rung rinh trong gió.
en: The little warbler tilts its head, pecks at the green caterpillar on the branch, hops a step along the branch and flicks its tail, the green leaves tremble in the breeze, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful little chirp, a tiny peck and rustling leaves.

vi: Trăng tròn sáng dịu, mây mỏng trôi qua; hai bạn ngước nhìn trăng, tàu chuối và hàng cau đung đưa, bóng lá lay động trên sân.
en: On the moonlit night: the full moon glows softly and a thin cloud drifts past it, the two children gaze up at the moon and the girl smiles, the banana leaves and areca palms sway gently, their shadows move on the yard, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: crickets, a soft night breeze and rustling banana leaves.

vi: Cái xẻng tự xúc một nhát đất, hất đất lên rồi cắm lại vào đống đất như cũ.
en: The shovel comes alive: it pulls itself out of the soil mound, scoops up a load of earth, tosses it in a little arc, then digs back into the mound and stands in the exact original position. Sound: a metal blade crunching into soil and falling dirt.

vi: Chị giơ ngón tay ra câu đố, em chống cằm nghĩ, mắt đảo quanh, rồi chợt mỉm cười như vừa đoán ra.
en: The older sister raises her finger and asks a riddle with a playful smile, the younger girl rests her chin on her hands, looks up and around thinking hard, then suddenly smiles brightly as if she has the answer, the curtains at the window flutter, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: a playful 'hmm' (no words), a soft ding of an idea and birdsong.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the single bottom-right brick lying on the paper, with no other bricks.
vi: Từng viên gạch đỏ trượt vào, xếp chồng lên nhau cạch cạch cho đến khi thành chồng gạch như tranh.
en: Stacking animation from the first frame to the last: one red brick after another slides in from the side and settles into place with a solid clack, building up the stack layer by layer until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: heavy brick clacks and a little dust puff.

vi: Chiếc cày tự lướt tới, lưỡi gang xẻ một luống đất, đất lật lên, rồi cày trở lại đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The plough comes alive: it glides forward and its shiny cast-iron blade cuts a furrow through a strip of brown soil that appears beneath it, the earth curls over in a neat wave, then the soil fades away and the plough returns to the exact original position. Sound: soil being cut and turned, a wooden creak and birdsong.

vi: Chú thợ mỏ dắt cháu đi, chỉ tay về đoàn goòng than đang lăn trên ray, đèn mũ và đèn hầm lấp lánh; cháu ngước nhìn thích thú.
en: The miner walks hand in hand with the boy and points at the coal carts, the carts roll slowly along the rails, the lamp on his helmet and the tunnel lamp glow and flicker, the boy looks up at him with wide, curious eyes, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rumbling cart wheels on rails, footsteps and a faint echo in the tunnel.

vi: Hai con cua bò ngang khỏi hang, giơ càng; cá rô phi nhảy vọt lên tõm xuống nước; bác trâu cười; máy cày xa xa chạy trên ruộng.
en: The two crabs scuttle sideways out of their hole and wave their claws, the tilapia leaps out of the water and splashes back down, the buffalo grins and nods, the farmer on the tractor drives along the far field, the rice plants sway, then everything returns to the exact original picture. Sound: a splash, clicking crab claws, a buffalo low and a tractor putt-putt far away.

start: Keep the same river, coconut palms, houses, sailing boat, clouds and style, but it is just before sunrise: the sun is still hidden below the horizon with only a soft pale glow there, and no sun rays on the water.
vi: Mặt trời từ từ nhô lên ở chân trời, tia nắng toả ra, mặt sông lấp lánh, thuyền buồm trôi nhẹ, hàng dừa đung đưa.
en: Sunrise animation from the first frame to the last: the sun slowly rises above the horizon, its rays spread out and the river begins to shimmer with golden reflections, the sailing boat drifts gently, the coconut palms sway, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft morning birdsong, gentle lapping water and a rooster crowing far away.

vi: Sóng biển nhẹ nhàng xô vào bờ cát rồi rút ra, hàng dương reo trong gió, bông hoa trắng khẽ rung; yên bình, trang nghiêm.
en: Calm and peaceful: gentle waves roll up onto the sandy shore and slide back, the casuarina trees sway and whisper in the sea breeze, the white flower under the tree trembles softly, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft waves, the whistling of the casuarina trees in the wind, no music.

vi: Bác nông dân chỉ tay về phía gấu; con gấu đen to lớn khịt mũi, gật gù; lá củ cải rung rinh, cây rừng đung đưa.
en: The farmer points toward the forest and leans on his hoe, the big black bear sniffs the air, nods its head and shifts its weight, the radish leaves rustle, the forest trees sway, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: a bear's grunt and snuffle, rustling leaves and forest birds (no words).

vi: Cô giáo vẫy tay chào, các bạn giơ tay reo, mũ tung lên cao rồi rơi xuống; cửa sổ nắng sáng.
en: Goodbye to grade one: the teacher waves and smiles warmly, the pupils raise their arms and cheer, the caps fly up into the air, spin and fall back down, the sunlight through the window brightens, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children cheering (no words), clapping and a school bell.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, and the same square tin box, but with its decorated lid closed on top, so no biscuits are visible.
vi: Nắp hộp bánh từ từ mở ra, nghiêng sang bên, lộ ra những chiếc bánh quy vàng thơm.
en: Opening animation from the first frame to the last: the lid of the tin box lifts up with a little pop, tilts and settles beside the box, revealing the golden round biscuits inside, a few tiny sparkles twinkle, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a metal tin lid pop, a soft clink and a happy little chime.

start: Keep the same paper background, leaves and style, but show two whole green limes side by side, both uncut, no lime half.
vi: Một quả chanh được con dao vô hình bổ đôi, nửa quả lăn ra để lộ ruột chanh mọng nước, giọt nước chanh bắn nhẹ.
en: Cutting animation from the first frame to the last: an invisible knife slices the right lime in half with a crisp cut, one half rolls away out of sight and the other half turns face up showing the juicy pale-green flesh, a few drops of juice sparkle, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a crisp slice, a juicy squish and a tiny drip.

vi: Nắp cặp tự bật mở, quyển vở lật trang phần phật, chồng sách nhảy nhẹ, rồi nắp cặp đóng lại như cũ.
en: The school bag comes alive: its flap pops open and closes like a smile, the notebook's pages flutter, the stack of books hops gently, the strap swings, then everything settles back into the exact original position. Sound: a buckle click, fluttering pages and a soft book thump.

vi: Con tàu rẽ sóng tiến lên, sóng biển tung bọt trắng, lá cờ và cánh buồm bay phần phật, khói nhẹ bay lên.
en: The big ship ploughs through the sea, waves rise and break into white foam around the bow, the ship rocks gently, the flag and the sail flutter in the wind, a light puff of smoke rises from the funnel, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: crashing waves, wind, a deep ship horn and seagulls.
